+class GridRefinement(TaggedModel):
+    """Local refinement metadata for AutoGrid planning."""
+
+    type: Literal["GridRefinement"] = "GridRefinement"
+    refinement_factor: float | None = None
+    dl: float | None = None
+    num_cells: int = 3
+
+    @field_validator("refinement_factor")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_refinement_factor(cls, value: float | None) -> float | None:
+        if value is None:
+            return None
+        return _positive_float(value, field_name="refinement_factor")
+
+    @field_validator("dl")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_dl(cls, value: float | None) -> float | None:
+        if value is None:
+            return None
+        return _positive_float(value, field_name="dl")
+
+    @field_validator("num_cells")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_num_cells(cls, value: int) -> int:
+        return _positive_int(value, field_name="num_cells")
+
+    @property
+    def effective_refinement_factor(self) -> float | None:
+        """Return the refinement factor that should be applied in Phase 1."""
+        if self.refinement_factor is None and self.dl is None:
+            return _DEFAULT_REFINEMENT_FACTOR
+        return self.refinement_factor
+
+    def effective_dl(self, *, vacuum_dl: float) -> float:
+        """Return the smallest cell width requested by this refinement."""
+        base = _positive_float(vacuum_dl, field_name="vacuum_dl")
+        refined = math.inf
+        if self.effective_refinement_factor is not None:
+            refined = min(refined, base / self.effective_refinement_factor)
+        if self.dl is not None:
+            refined = min(refined, self.dl)
+        if not math.isfinite(refined):
+            raise ValueError("grid refinement could not determine a target dl")
+        return refined
+
+
+class LayerRefinementSpec(TaggedModel):
+    """Layer-aware AutoGrid refinement metadata with an explicit Phase 1 subset."""
+
+    type: Literal["LayerRefinementSpec"] = "LayerRefinementSpec"
+    axis: int
+    center: Vec3
+    size: Vec3
+    min_steps_along_axis: float | None = None
+    bounds_refinement: GridRefinement | None = None
+    bounds_snapping: Literal["bounds", "lower", "upper", "center"] | None = "lower"
+
+    @field_validator("axis")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_axis(cls, value: int) -> int:
+        return _axis_name_to_index(value)
+
+    @field_validator("center")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_center(cls, value: Vec3) -> Vec3:
+        return tuple(_finite_float(component, field_name="center") for component in value)
+
+    @field_validator("size")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_size(cls, value: Vec3) -> Vec3:
+        normalized = tuple(_finite_float(component, field_name="size") for component in value)
+        if any(component < 0.0 for component in normalized):
+            raise ValueError("size components must be non-negative")
+        return normalized
+
+    @field_validator("min_steps_along_axis")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_min_steps(cls, value: float | None) -> float | None:
+        if value is None:
+            return None
+        return _positive_float(value, field_name="min_steps_along_axis")
+
+    @property
+    def bounds(self) -> tuple[Vec3, Vec3]:
+        """Return axis-aligned layer bounds."""
+        lower = tuple(c - s / 2.0 for c, s in zip(self.center, self.size, strict=True))
+        upper = tuple(c + s / 2.0 for c, s in zip(self.center, self.size, strict=True))
+        return (lower, upper)
+
+    def axis_bounds(self) -> tuple[float, float]:
+        """Return the lower and upper coordinates along the normal axis."""
+        lower, upper = self.bounds
+        return (lower[self.axis], upper[self.axis])
+
+    def snapping_points(self) -> tuple[float, ...]:
+        """Return snapping points implied by the current layer configuration."""
+        lower, upper = self.axis_bounds()
+        center = self.center[self.axis]
+        mode = self.bounds_snapping
+        if mode is None:
+            return ()
+        if mode == "bounds":
+            return (lower, upper)
+        if mode == "lower":
+            return (lower,)
+        if mode == "upper":
+            return (upper,)
+        return (center,)
+
+    def target_dl(self, *, base_dl: float) -> float | None:
+        """Return the smallest requested dl inside the layer body, if any."""
+        target = math.inf
+        thickness = self.size[self.axis]
+        if self.min_steps_along_axis is not None and thickness > 0.0:
+            target = min(target, thickness / math.ceil(self.min_steps_along_axis))
+        if self.bounds_refinement is not None:
+            target = min(target, self.bounds_refinement.effective_dl(vacuum_dl=base_dl))
+        if not math.isfinite(target):
+            return None
+        return target
+
+
+class AutoGrid(TaggedModel):
+    """Simplified AutoGrid meshing policy with explicit Phase 1 limitations."""
+
+    type: Literal["AutoGrid"] = "AutoGrid"
+    min_steps_per_wvl: float = _DEFAULT_AUTOGRID_STEPS_PER_WVL
+    min_steps_per_sim_size: float = _DEFAULT_AUTOGRID_STEPS_PER_SIM_SIZE
+    max_scale: float = _DEFAULT_AUTOGRID_MAX_SCALE
+    dl_min: float | None = None
+
+    @field_validator("min_steps_per_wvl")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_min_steps_per_wvl(cls, value: float) -> float:
+        numeric = _positive_float(value, field_name="min_steps_per_wvl")
+        if numeric < 6.0:
+            raise ValueError("min_steps_per_wvl must be at least 6.0 for Phase 1 AutoGrid")
+        return numeric
+
+    @field_validator("min_steps_per_sim_size")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_min_steps_per_sim_size(cls, value: float) -> float:
+        if float(value) < 1.0:
+            raise ValueError("min_steps_per_sim_size must be at least 1.0")
+        return _positive_float(value, field_name="min_steps_per_sim_size")
+
+    @field_validator("max_scale")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_max_scale(cls, value: float) -> float:
+        numeric = _positive_float(value, field_name="max_scale")
+        if numeric < 1.0:
+            raise ValueError("max_scale must be at least 1.0")
+        return numeric
+
+    @field_validator("dl_min")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_dl_min(cls, value: float | None) -> float | None:
+        if value is None:
+            return None
+        return _positive_float(value, field_name="dl_min")
+
+    def estimated_min_dl(self, *, wavelength: float, sim_size: Vec3) -> float:
+        """Return the Phase 1 vacuum-based lower bound for this AutoGrid."""
+        wavelength_dl = _positive_float(wavelength, field_name="wavelength") / self.min_steps_per_wvl
+        sim_dl = max(_positive_float(length, field_name="sim_size") for length in sim_size if length > 0.0)
+        sim_dl /= self.min_steps_per_sim_size
+        target = min(wavelength_dl, sim_dl)
+        if self.dl_min is not None:
+            target = max(target, self.dl_min)
+        return target
+
+    def make_boundaries(
+        self,
+        *,
+        center: float,
+        size: float,
+        wavelength: float,
+        sim_size: Vec3,
+        layer_refinement_specs: Iterable[LayerRefinementSpec] = (),
+    ) -> tuple[float, ...]:
+        """Resolve a simplified AutoGrid axis with optional layer refinement metadata."""
+        axis_min, axis_max = _normalize_axis_bounds(center=center, size=size)
+        tolerance = max(1e-12, abs(size) * 1e-9)
+        if math.isclose(axis_min, axis_max, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=tolerance):
+            return (axis_min, axis_max)
+
+        base_dl = self.estimated_min_dl(wavelength=wavelength, sim_size=sim_size)
+        regions: list[tuple[float, float, float]] = []
+        snapping_points = {axis_min, axis_max}
+
+        for spec in layer_refinement_specs:
+            lower, upper = spec.axis_bounds()
+            clipped_lower = max(axis_min, lower)
+            clipped_upper = min(axis_max, upper)
+            if clipped_upper < axis_min - tolerance or clipped_lower > axis_max + tolerance:
+                continue
+
+            target_dl = spec.target_dl(base_dl=base_dl)
+            if target_dl is not None and clipped_upper - clipped_lower > tolerance:
+                regions.append((clipped_lower, clipped_upper, target_dl))
+
+            if spec.bounds_refinement is not None:
+                boundary_dl = spec.bounds_refinement.effective_dl(vacuum_dl=base_dl)
+                half_width = boundary_dl * spec.bounds_refinement.num_cells / 2.0
+                for point in spec.snapping_points():
+                    snapped = _snap_to_axis(
+                        point, axis_min=axis_min, axis_max=axis_max, tolerance=tolerance
+                    )
+                    if snapped is None:
+                        continue
+                    snapping_points.add(snapped)
+                    regions.append(
+                        (
+                            max(axis_min, snapped - half_width),
+                            min(axis_max, snapped + half_width),
+                            boundary_dl,
+                        )
+                    )
+            else:
+                for point in spec.snapping_points():
+                    snapped = _snap_to_axis(
+                        point, axis_min=axis_min, axis_max=axis_max, tolerance=tolerance
+                    )
+                    if snapped is not None:
+                        snapping_points.add(snapped)
+
+        breakpoints = sorted(snapping_points | {start for start, _, _ in regions} | {end for _, end, _ in regions})
+        boundaries = [axis_min]
+        for segment_start, segment_end in zip(breakpoints, breakpoints[1:], strict=False):
+            if math.isclose(segment_start, segment_end, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=tolerance):
+                continue
+            midpoint = (segment_start + segment_end) / 2.0
+            target_dl = min(
+                (dl for start, end, dl in regions if start - tolerance <= midpoint <= end + tolerance),
+                default=base_dl,
+            )
+            num_cells = max(1, math.ceil((segment_end - segment_start) / target_dl))
+            snapped_dl = (segment_end - segment_start) / num_cells
+            for index in range(1, num_cells + 1):
+                boundaries.append(segment_start + snapped_dl * index)
+
+        graded = self._enforce_max_scale(boundaries, tolerance=tolerance)
+        return _deduplicate_coords(graded, tolerance=tolerance)
+
+    def _enforce_max_scale(self, boundaries: list[float], *, tolerance: float) -> list[float]:
+        if len(boundaries) < 3 or self.max_scale <= 1.0:
+            return boundaries
+
+        graded = list(boundaries)
+        changed = True
+        while changed:
+            changed = False
+            cell_sizes = [upper - lower for lower, upper in zip(graded, graded[1:], strict=False)]
+            for index in range(len(cell_sizes) - 1):
+                left = cell_sizes[index]
+                right = cell_sizes[index + 1]
+                if left <= tolerance or right <= tolerance:
+                    continue
+                ratio = max(left, right) / min(left, right)
+                if ratio <= self.max_scale + 1e-12:
+                    continue
+                if left > right:
+                    graded.insert(index + 1, (graded[index] + graded[index + 1]) / 2.0)
+                else:
+                    graded.insert(index + 2, (graded[index + 1] + graded[index + 2]) / 2.0)
+                changed = True
+                break
+        return graded
+

+def _snap_to_axis(point: float, *, axis_min: float, axis_max: float, tolerance: float) -> float | None:
+    if point < axis_min - tolerance or point > axis_max + tolerance:
+        return None
+    if math.isclose(point, axis_min, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=tolerance):
+        return axis_min
+    if math.isclose(point, axis_max, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=tolerance):
+        return axis_max
+    return _finite_float(point, field_name="snapping point")
+
+
+def _axis_name_to_index(axis: AxisName | int) -> int:
+    if axis in (0, 1, 2):
+        return int(axis)
+    axis_map = {"x": 0, "y": 1, "z": 2}
+    if isinstance(axis, str) and axis.lower() in axis_map:
+        return axis_map[axis.lower()]
+    raise ValueError("axis must be one of 0, 1, 2, 'x', 'y', or 'z'")

+class GridRefinement(TaggedModel):
+    """Local refinement metadata for AutoGrid planning."""
+
+    type: Literal["GridRefinement"] = "GridRefinement"
+    refinement_factor: float | None = None
+    dl: float | None = None
+    num_cells: int = 3
+
+    @field_validator("refinement_factor")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_refinement_factor(cls, value: float | None) -> float | None:
+        if value is None:
+            return None
+        return _positive_float(value, field_name="refinement_factor")
+
+    @field_validator("dl")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_dl(cls, value: float | None) -> float | None:
+        if value is None:
+            return None
+        return _positive_float(value, field_name="dl")
+
+    @field_validator("num_cells")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_num_cells(cls, value: int) -> int:
+        return _positive_int(value, field_name="num_cells")
+
+    @property
+    def effective_refinement_factor(self) -> float | None:
+        """Return the refinement factor that should be applied in Phase 1."""
+        if self.refinement_factor is None and self.dl is None:
+            return _DEFAULT_REFINEMENT_FACTOR
+        return self.refinement_factor
+
+    def effective_dl(self, *, vacuum_dl: float) -> float:
+        """Return the smallest cell width requested by this refinement."""
+        base = _positive_float(vacuum_dl, field_name="vacuum_dl")
+        refined = math.inf
+        if self.effective_refinement_factor is not None:
+            refined = min(refined, base / self.effective_refinement_factor)
+        if self.dl is not None:
+            refined = min(refined, self.dl)
+        if not math.isfinite(refined):
+            raise ValueError("grid refinement could not determine a target dl")
+        return refined
+
+
+class LayerRefinementSpec(TaggedModel):
+    """Layer-aware AutoGrid refinement metadata with an explicit Phase 1 subset."""
+
+    type: Literal["LayerRefinementSpec"] = "LayerRefinementSpec"
+    axis: int
+    center: Vec3
+    size: Vec3
+    min_steps_along_axis: float | None = None
+    bounds_refinement: GridRefinement | None = None
+    bounds_snapping: Literal["bounds", "lower", "upper", "center"] | None = "lower"
+
+    @field_validator("axis")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_axis(cls, value: int) -> int:
+        return _axis_name_to_index(value)
+
+    @field_validator("center")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_center(cls, value: Vec3) -> Vec3:
+        return tuple(_finite_float(component, field_name="center") for component in value)
+
+    @field_validator("size")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_size(cls, value: Vec3) -> Vec3:
+        normalized = tuple(_finite_float(component, field_name="size") for component in value)
+        if any(component < 0.0 for component in normalized):
+            raise ValueError("size components must be non-negative")
+        return normalized
+
+    @field_validator("min_steps_along_axis")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_min_steps(cls, value: float | None) -> float | None:
+        if value is None:
+            return None
+        return _positive_float(value, field_name="min_steps_along_axis")
+
+    @property
+    def bounds(self) -> tuple[Vec3, Vec3]:
+        """Return axis-aligned layer bounds."""
+        lower = tuple(c - s / 2.0 for c, s in zip(self.center, self.size, strict=True))
+        upper = tuple(c + s / 2.0 for c, s in zip(self.center, self.size, strict=True))
+        return (lower, upper)
+
+    def axis_bounds(self) -> tuple[float, float]:
+        """Return the lower and upper coordinates along the normal axis."""
+        lower, upper = self.bounds
+        return (lower[self.axis], upper[self.axis])
+
+    def snapping_points(self) -> tuple[float, ...]:
+        """Return snapping points implied by the current layer configuration."""
+        lower, upper = self.axis_bounds()
+        center = self.center[self.axis]
+        mode = self.bounds_snapping
+        if mode is None:
+            return ()
+        if mode == "bounds":
+            return (lower, upper)
+        if mode == "lower":
+            return (lower,)
+        if mode == "upper":
+            return (upper,)
+        return (center,)
+
+    def target_dl(self, *, base_dl: float) -> float | None:
+        """Return the smallest requested dl inside the layer body, if any."""
+        target = math.inf
+        thickness = self.size[self.axis]
+        if self.min_steps_along_axis is not None and thickness > 0.0:
+            target = min(target, thickness / math.ceil(self.min_steps_along_axis))
+        if self.bounds_refinement is not None:
+            target = min(target, self.bounds_refinement.effective_dl(vacuum_dl=base_dl))
+        if not math.isfinite(target):
+            return None
+        return target
+
+
+class AutoGrid(TaggedModel):
+    """Simplified AutoGrid meshing policy with explicit Phase 1 limitations."""
+
+    type: Literal["AutoGrid"] = "AutoGrid"
+    min_steps_per_wvl: float = _DEFAULT_AUTOGRID_STEPS_PER_WVL
+    min_steps_per_sim_size: float = _DEFAULT_AUTOGRID_STEPS_PER_SIM_SIZE
+    max_scale: float = _DEFAULT_AUTOGRID_MAX_SCALE
+    dl_min: float | None = None
+
+    @field_validator("min_steps_per_wvl")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_min_steps_per_wvl(cls, value: float) -> float:
+        numeric = _positive_float(value, field_name="min_steps_per_wvl")
+        if numeric < 6.0:
+            raise ValueError("min_steps_per_wvl must be at least 6.0 for Phase 1 AutoGrid")
+        return numeric
+
+    @field_validator("min_steps_per_sim_size")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_min_steps_per_sim_size(cls, value: float) -> float:
+        if float(value) < 1.0:
+            raise ValueError("min_steps_per_sim_size must be at least 1.0")
+        return _positive_float(value, field_name="min_steps_per_sim_size")
+
+    @field_validator("max_scale")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_max_scale(cls, value: float) -> float:
+        numeric = _positive_float(value, field_name="max_scale")
+        if numeric < 1.0:
+            raise ValueError("max_scale must be at least 1.0")
+        return numeric
+
+    @field_validator("dl_min")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_dl_min(cls, value: float | None) -> float | None:
+        if value is None:
+            return None
+        return _positive_float(value, field_name="dl_min")
+
+    def estimated_min_dl(self, *, wavelength: float, sim_size: Vec3) -> float:
+        """Return the Phase 1 vacuum-based lower bound for this AutoGrid."""
+        wavelength_dl = _positive_float(wavelength, field_name="wavelength") / self.min_steps_per_wvl
+        sim_dl = max(_positive_float(length, field_name="sim_size") for length in sim_size if length > 0.0)
+        sim_dl /= self.min_steps_per_sim_size
+        target = min(wavelength_dl, sim_dl)
+        if self.dl_min is not None:
+            target = max(target, self.dl_min)
+        return target
+
+    def make_boundaries(
+        self,
+        *,
+        center: float,
+        size: float,
+        wavelength: float,
+        sim_size: Vec3,
+        layer_refinement_specs: Iterable[LayerRefinementSpec] = (),
+    ) -> tuple[float, ...]:
+        """Resolve a simplified AutoGrid axis with optional layer refinement metadata."""
+        axis_min, axis_max = _normalize_axis_bounds(center=center, size=size)
+        tolerance = max(1e-12, abs(size) * 1e-9)
+        if math.isclose(axis_min, axis_max, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=tolerance):
+            return (axis_min, axis_max)
+
+        base_dl = self.estimated_min_dl(wavelength=wavelength, sim_size=sim_size)
+        regions: list[tuple[float, float, float]] = []
+        snapping_points = {axis_min, axis_max}
+
+        for spec in layer_refinement_specs:
+            lower, upper = spec.axis_bounds()
+            clipped_lower = max(axis_min, lower)
+            clipped_upper = min(axis_max, upper)
+            if clipped_upper < axis_min - tolerance or clipped_lower > axis_max + tolerance:
+                continue
+
+            target_dl = spec.target_dl(base_dl=base_dl)
+            if target_dl is not None and clipped_upper - clipped_lower > tolerance:
+                regions.append((clipped_lower, clipped_upper, target_dl))
+
+            if spec.bounds_refinement is not None:
+                boundary_dl = spec.bounds_refinement.effective_dl(vacuum_dl=base_dl)
+                half_width = boundary_dl * spec.bounds_refinement.num_cells / 2.0
+                for point in spec.snapping_points():
+                    snapped = _snap_to_axis(
+                        point, axis_min=axis_min, axis_max=axis_max, tolerance=tolerance
+                    )
+                    if snapped is None:
+                        continue
+                    snapping_points.add(snapped)
+                    regions.append(
+                        (
+                            max(axis_min, snapped - half_width),
+                            min(axis_max, snapped + half_width),
+                            boundary_dl,
+                        )
+                    )
+            else:
+                for point in spec.snapping_points():
+                    snapped = _snap_to_axis(
+                        point, axis_min=axis_min, axis_max=axis_max, tolerance=tolerance
+                    )
+                    if snapped is not None:
+                        snapping_points.add(snapped)
+
+        breakpoints = sorted(snapping_points | {start for start, _, _ in regions} | {end for _, end, _ in regions})
+        boundaries = [axis_min]
+        for segment_start, segment_end in zip(breakpoints, breakpoints[1:], strict=False):
+            if math.isclose(segment_start, segment_end, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=tolerance):
+                continue
+            midpoint = (segment_start + segment_end) / 2.0
+            target_dl = min(
+                (dl for start, end, dl in regions if start - tolerance <= midpoint <= end + tolerance),
+                default=base_dl,
+            )
+            num_cells = max(1, math.ceil((segment_end - segment_start) / target_dl))
+            snapped_dl = (segment_end - segment_start) / num_cells
+            for index in range(1, num_cells + 1):
+                boundaries.append(segment_start + snapped_dl * index)
+
+        graded = self._enforce_max_scale(boundaries, tolerance=tolerance)
+        return _deduplicate_coords(graded, tolerance=tolerance)
+
+    def _enforce_max_scale(self, boundaries: list[float], *, tolerance: float) -> list[float]:
+        if len(boundaries) < 3 or self.max_scale <= 1.0:
+            return boundaries
+
+        graded = list(boundaries)
+        changed = True
+        while changed:
+            changed = False
+            cell_sizes = [upper - lower for lower, upper in zip(graded, graded[1:], strict=False)]
+            for index in range(len(cell_sizes) - 1):
+                left = cell_sizes[index]
+                right = cell_sizes[index + 1]
+                if left <= tolerance or right <= tolerance:
+                    continue
+                ratio = max(left, right) / min(left, right)
+                if ratio <= self.max_scale + 1e-12:
+                    continue
+                if left > right:
+                    graded.insert(index + 1, (graded[index] + graded[index + 1]) / 2.0)
+                else:
+                    graded.insert(index + 2, (graded[index + 1] + graded[index + 2]) / 2.0)
+                changed = True
+                break
+        return graded
+

 AxisGridSpec = Annotated[

+def _snap_to_axis(point: float, *, axis_min: float, axis_max: float, tolerance: float) -> float | None:
+    if point < axis_min - tolerance or point > axis_max + tolerance:
+        return None
+    if math.isclose(point, axis_min, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=tolerance):
+        return axis_min
+    if math.isclose(point, axis_max, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=tolerance):
+        return axis_max
+    return _finite_float(point, field_name="snapping point")
+
+
+def _axis_name_to_index(axis: AxisName | int) -> int:
+    if axis in (0, 1, 2):
+        return int(axis)
+    axis_map = {"x": 0, "y": 1, "z": 2}
+    if isinstance(axis, str) and axis.lower() in axis_map:
+        return axis_map[axis.lower()]
+    raise ValueError("axis must be one of 0, 1, 2, 'x', 'y', or 'z'")

+class GridRefinement(TaggedModel):
+    """Local refinement metadata for AutoGrid planning."""
+
+    type: Literal["GridRefinement"] = "GridRefinement"
+    refinement_factor: float | None = None
+    dl: float | None = None
+    num_cells: int = 3
+
+    @field_validator("refinement_factor")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_refinement_factor(cls, value: float | None) -> float | None:
+        if value is None:
+            return None
+        return _positive_float(value, field_name="refinement_factor")
+
+    @field_validator("dl")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_dl(cls, value: float | None) -> float | None:
+        if value is None:
+            return None
+        return _positive_float(value, field_name="dl")
+
+    @field_validator("num_cells")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_num_cells(cls, value: int) -> int:
+        return _positive_int(value, field_name="num_cells")
+
+    @property
+    def effective_refinement_factor(self) -> float | None:
+        """Return the refinement factor that should be applied in Phase 1."""
+        if self.refinement_factor is None and self.dl is None:
+            return _DEFAULT_REFINEMENT_FACTOR
+        return self.refinement_factor
+
+    def effective_dl(self, *, vacuum_dl: float) -> float:
+        """Return the smallest cell width requested by this refinement."""
+        base = _positive_float(vacuum_dl, field_name="vacuum_dl")
+        refined = math.inf
+        if self.effective_refinement_factor is not None:
+            refined = min(refined, base / self.effective_refinement_factor)
+        if self.dl is not None:
+            refined = min(refined, self.dl)
+        if not math.isfinite(refined):
+            raise ValueError("grid refinement could not determine a target dl")
+        return refined
+
+
+class LayerRefinementSpec(TaggedModel):
+    """Layer-aware AutoGrid refinement metadata with an explicit Phase 1 subset."""
+
+    type: Literal["LayerRefinementSpec"] = "LayerRefinementSpec"
+    axis: int
+    center: Vec3
+    size: Vec3
+    min_steps_along_axis: float | None = None
+    bounds_refinement: GridRefinement | None = None
+    bounds_snapping: Literal["bounds", "lower", "upper", "center"] | None = "lower"
+
+    @field_validator("axis")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_axis(cls, value: int) -> int:
+        return _axis_name_to_index(value)
+
+    @field_validator("center")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_center(cls, value: Vec3) -> Vec3:
+        return tuple(_finite_float(component, field_name="center") for component in value)
+
+    @field_validator("size")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_size(cls, value: Vec3) -> Vec3:
+        normalized = tuple(_finite_float(component, field_name="size") for component in value)
+        if any(component < 0.0 for component in normalized):
+            raise ValueError("size components must be non-negative")
+        return normalized
+
+    @field_validator("min_steps_along_axis")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_min_steps(cls, value: float | None) -> float | None:
+        if value is None:
+            return None
+        return _positive_float(value, field_name="min_steps_along_axis")
+
+    @property
+    def bounds(self) -> tuple[Vec3, Vec3]:
+        """Return axis-aligned layer bounds."""
+        lower = tuple(c - s / 2.0 for c, s in zip(self.center, self.size, strict=True))
+        upper = tuple(c + s / 2.0 for c, s in zip(self.center, self.size, strict=True))
+        return (lower, upper)
+
+    def axis_bounds(self) -> tuple[float, float]:
+        """Return the lower and upper coordinates along the normal axis."""
+        lower, upper = self.bounds
+        return (lower[self.axis], upper[self.axis])
+
+    def snapping_points(self) -> tuple[float, ...]:
+        """Return snapping points implied by the current layer configuration."""
+        lower, upper = self.axis_bounds()
+        center = self.center[self.axis]
+        mode = self.bounds_snapping
+        if mode is None:
+            return ()
+        if mode == "bounds":
+            return (lower, upper)
+        if mode == "lower":
+            return (lower,)
+        if mode == "upper":
+            return (upper,)
+        return (center,)
+
+    def target_dl(self, *, base_dl: float) -> float | None:
+        """Return the smallest requested dl inside the layer body, if any."""
+        target = math.inf
+        thickness = self.size[self.axis]
+        if self.min_steps_along_axis is not None and thickness > 0.0:
+            target = min(target, thickness / math.ceil(self.min_steps_along_axis))
+        if self.bounds_refinement is not None:
+            target = min(target, self.bounds_refinement.effective_dl(vacuum_dl=base_dl))
+        if not math.isfinite(target):
+            return None
+        return target
+
+
+class AutoGrid(TaggedModel):
+    """Simplified AutoGrid meshing policy with explicit Phase 1 limitations."""
+
+    type: Literal["AutoGrid"] = "AutoGrid"
+    min_steps_per_wvl: float = _DEFAULT_AUTOGRID_STEPS_PER_WVL
+    min_steps_per_sim_size: float = _DEFAULT_AUTOGRID_STEPS_PER_SIM_SIZE
+    max_scale: float = _DEFAULT_AUTOGRID_MAX_SCALE
+    dl_min: float | None = None
+
+    @field_validator("min_steps_per_wvl")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_min_steps_per_wvl(cls, value: float) -> float:
+        numeric = _positive_float(value, field_name="min_steps_per_wvl")
+        if numeric < 6.0:
+            raise ValueError("min_steps_per_wvl must be at least 6.0 for Phase 1 AutoGrid")
+        return numeric
+
+    @field_validator("min_steps_per_sim_size")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_min_steps_per_sim_size(cls, value: float) -> float:
+        if float(value) < 1.0:
+            raise ValueError("min_steps_per_sim_size must be at least 1.0")
+        return _positive_float(value, field_name="min_steps_per_sim_size")
+
+    @field_validator("max_scale")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_max_scale(cls, value: float) -> float:
+        numeric = _positive_float(value, field_name="max_scale")
+        if numeric < 1.0:
+            raise ValueError("max_scale must be at least 1.0")
+        return numeric
+
+    @field_validator("dl_min")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_dl_min(cls, value: float | None) -> float | None:
+        if value is None:
+            return None
+        return _positive_float(value, field_name="dl_min")
+
+    def estimated_min_dl(self, *, wavelength: float, sim_size: Vec3) -> float:
+        """Return the Phase 1 vacuum-based lower bound for this AutoGrid."""
+        wavelength_dl = _positive_float(wavelength, field_name="wavelength") / self.min_steps_per_wvl
+        sim_dl = max(_positive_float(length, field_name="sim_size") for length in sim_size if length > 0.0)
+        sim_dl /= self.min_steps_per_sim_size
+        target = min(wavelength_dl, sim_dl)
+        if self.dl_min is not None:
+            target = max(target, self.dl_min)
+        return target
+
+    def make_boundaries(
+        self,
+        *,
+        center: float,
+        size: float,
+        wavelength: float,
+        sim_size: Vec3,
+        layer_refinement_specs: Iterable[LayerRefinementSpec] = (),
+    ) -> tuple[float, ...]:
+        """Resolve a simplified AutoGrid axis with optional layer refinement metadata."""
+        axis_min, axis_max = _normalize_axis_bounds(center=center, size=size)
+        tolerance = max(1e-12, abs(size) * 1e-9)
+        if math.isclose(axis_min, axis_max, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=tolerance):
+            return (axis_min, axis_max)
+
+        base_dl = self.estimated_min_dl(wavelength=wavelength, sim_size=sim_size)
+        regions: list[tuple[float, float, float]] = []
+        snapping_points = {axis_min, axis_max}
+
+        for spec in layer_refinement_specs:
+            lower, upper = spec.axis_bounds()
+            clipped_lower = max(axis_min, lower)
+            clipped_upper = min(axis_max, upper)
+            if clipped_upper < axis_min - tolerance or clipped_lower > axis_max + tolerance:
+                continue
+
+            target_dl = spec.target_dl(base_dl=base_dl)
+            if target_dl is not None and clipped_upper - clipped_lower > tolerance:
+                regions.append((clipped_lower, clipped_upper, target_dl))
+
+            if spec.bounds_refinement is not None:
+                boundary_dl = spec.bounds_refinement.effective_dl(vacuum_dl=base_dl)
+                half_width = boundary_dl * spec.bounds_refinement.num_cells / 2.0
+                for point in spec.snapping_points():
+                    snapped = _snap_to_axis(
+                        point, axis_min=axis_min, axis_max=axis_max, tolerance=tolerance
+                    )
+                    if snapped is None:
+                        continue
+                    snapping_points.add(snapped)
+                    regions.append(
+                        (
+                            max(axis_min, snapped - half_width),
+                            min(axis_max, snapped + half_width),
+                            boundary_dl,
+                        )
+                    )
+            else:
+                for point in spec.snapping_points():
+                    snapped = _snap_to_axis(
+                        point, axis_min=axis_min, axis_max=axis_max, tolerance=tolerance
+                    )
+                    if snapped is not None:
+                        snapping_points.add(snapped)
+
+        breakpoints = sorted(snapping_points | {start for start, _, _ in regions} | {end for _, end, _ in regions})
+        boundaries = [axis_min]
+        for segment_start, segment_end in zip(breakpoints, breakpoints[1:], strict=False):
+            if math.isclose(segment_start, segment_end, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=tolerance):
+                continue
+            midpoint = (segment_start + segment_end) / 2.0
+            target_dl = min(
+                (dl for start, end, dl in regions if start - tolerance <= midpoint <= end + tolerance),
+                default=base_dl,
+            )
+            num_cells = max(1, math.ceil((segment_end - segment_start) / target_dl))
+            snapped_dl = (segment_end - segment_start) / num_cells
+            for index in range(1, num_cells + 1):
+                boundaries.append(segment_start + snapped_dl * index)
+
+        graded = self._enforce_max_scale(boundaries, tolerance=tolerance)
+        return _deduplicate_coords(graded, tolerance=tolerance)
+
+    def _enforce_max_scale(self, boundaries: list[float], *, tolerance: float) -> list[float]:
+        if len(boundaries) < 3 or self.max_scale <= 1.0:
+            return boundaries
+
+        graded = list(boundaries)
+        changed = True
+        while changed:
+            changed = False
+            cell_sizes = [upper - lower for lower, upper in zip(graded, graded[1:], strict=False)]
+            for index in range(len(cell_sizes) - 1):
+                left = cell_sizes[index]
+                right = cell_sizes[index + 1]
+                if left <= tolerance or right <= tolerance:
+                    continue
+                ratio = max(left, right) / min(left, right)
+                if ratio <= self.max_scale + 1e-12:
+                    continue
+                if left > right:
+                    graded.insert(index + 1, (graded[index] + graded[index + 1]) / 2.0)
+                else:
+                    graded.insert(index + 2, (graded[index + 1] + graded[index + 2]) / 2.0)
+                changed = True
+                break
+        return graded
+

+def _positive_int(value: int, *, field_name: str) -> int:

+    if numeric <= 0:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field_name} must be a positive integer")

+def _snap_to_axis(point: float, *, axis_min: float, axis_max: float, tolerance: float) -> float | None:
+    if point < axis_min - tolerance or point > axis_max + tolerance:
+        return None
+    if math.isclose(point, axis_min, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=tolerance):
+        return axis_min
+    if math.isclose(point, axis_max, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=tolerance):
+        return axis_max
+    return _finite_float(point, field_name="snapping point")
+
+
+def _axis_name_to_index(axis: AxisName | int) -> int:
+    if axis in (0, 1, 2):
+        return int(axis)
+    axis_map = {"x": 0, "y": 1, "z": 2}
+    if isinstance(axis, str) and axis.lower() in axis_map:
+        return axis_map[axis.lower()]
+    raise ValueError("axis must be one of 0, 1, 2, 'x', 'y', or 'z'")

+class GridRefinement(TaggedModel):
+    """Local refinement metadata for AutoGrid planning."""
+
+    type: Literal["GridRefinement"] = "GridRefinement"
+    refinement_factor: float | None = None
+    dl: float | None = None
+    num_cells: int = 3
+
+    @field_validator("refinement_factor")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_refinement_factor(cls, value: float | None) -> float | None:
+        if value is None:
+            return None
+        return _positive_float(value, field_name="refinement_factor")
+
+    @field_validator("dl")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_dl(cls, value: float | None) -> float | None:
+        if value is None:
+            return None
+        return _positive_float(value, field_name="dl")
+
+    @field_validator("num_cells")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_num_cells(cls, value: int) -> int:
+        return _positive_int(value, field_name="num_cells")
+
+    @property
+    def effective_refinement_factor(self) -> float | None:
+        """Return the refinement factor that should be applied in Phase 1."""
+        if self.refinement_factor is None and self.dl is None:
+            return _DEFAULT_REFINEMENT_FACTOR
+        return self.refinement_factor
+
+    def effective_dl(self, *, vacuum_dl: float) -> float:
+        """Return the smallest cell width requested by this refinement."""
+        base = _positive_float(vacuum_dl, field_name="vacuum_dl")
+        refined = math.inf
+        if self.effective_refinement_factor is not None:
+            refined = min(refined, base / self.effective_refinement_factor)
+        if self.dl is not None:
+            refined = min(refined, self.dl)
+        if not math.isfinite(refined):
+            raise ValueError("grid refinement could not determine a target dl")
+        return refined
+
+
+class LayerRefinementSpec(TaggedModel):
+    """Layer-aware AutoGrid refinement metadata with an explicit Phase 1 subset."""
+
+    type: Literal["LayerRefinementSpec"] = "LayerRefinementSpec"
+    axis: int
+    center: Vec3
+    size: Vec3
+    min_steps_along_axis: float | None = None
+    bounds_refinement: GridRefinement | None = None
+    bounds_snapping: Literal["bounds", "lower", "upper", "center"] | None = "lower"
+
+    @field_validator("axis")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_axis(cls, value: int) -> int:
+        return _axis_name_to_index(value)
+
+    @field_validator("center")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_center(cls, value: Vec3) -> Vec3:
+        return tuple(_finite_float(component, field_name="center") for component in value)
+
+    @field_validator("size")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_size(cls, value: Vec3) -> Vec3:
+        normalized = tuple(_finite_float(component, field_name="size") for component in value)
+        if any(component < 0.0 for component in normalized):
+            raise ValueError("size components must be non-negative")
+        return normalized
+
+    @field_validator("min_steps_along_axis")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_min_steps(cls, value: float | None) -> float | None:
+        if value is None:
+            return None
+        return _positive_float(value, field_name="min_steps_along_axis")
+
+    @property
+    def bounds(self) -> tuple[Vec3, Vec3]:
+        """Return axis-aligned layer bounds."""
+        lower = tuple(c - s / 2.0 for c, s in zip(self.center, self.size, strict=True))
+        upper = tuple(c + s / 2.0 for c, s in zip(self.center, self.size, strict=True))
+        return (lower, upper)
+
+    def axis_bounds(self) -> tuple[float, float]:
+        """Return the lower and upper coordinates along the normal axis."""
+        lower, upper = self.bounds
+        return (lower[self.axis], upper[self.axis])
+
+    def snapping_points(self) -> tuple[float, ...]:
+        """Return snapping points implied by the current layer configuration."""
+        lower, upper = self.axis_bounds()
+        center = self.center[self.axis]
+        mode = self.bounds_snapping
+        if mode is None:
+            return ()
+        if mode == "bounds":
+            return (lower, upper)
+        if mode == "lower":
+            return (lower,)
+        if mode == "upper":
+            return (upper,)
+        return (center,)
+
+    def target_dl(self, *, base_dl: float) -> float | None:
+        """Return the smallest requested dl inside the layer body, if any."""
+        target = math.inf
+        thickness = self.size[self.axis]
+        if self.min_steps_along_axis is not None and thickness > 0.0:
+            target = min(target, thickness / math.ceil(self.min_steps_along_axis))
+        if self.bounds_refinement is not None:
+            target = min(target, self.bounds_refinement.effective_dl(vacuum_dl=base_dl))
+        if not math.isfinite(target):
+            return None
+        return target
+
+
+class AutoGrid(TaggedModel):
+    """Simplified AutoGrid meshing policy with explicit Phase 1 limitations."""
+
+    type: Literal["AutoGrid"] = "AutoGrid"
+    min_steps_per_wvl: float = _DEFAULT_AUTOGRID_STEPS_PER_WVL
+    min_steps_per_sim_size: float = _DEFAULT_AUTOGRID_STEPS_PER_SIM_SIZE
+    max_scale: float = _DEFAULT_AUTOGRID_MAX_SCALE
+    dl_min: float | None = None
+
+    @field_validator("min_steps_per_wvl")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_min_steps_per_wvl(cls, value: float) -> float:
+        numeric = _positive_float(value, field_name="min_steps_per_wvl")
+        if numeric < 6.0:
+            raise ValueError("min_steps_per_wvl must be at least 6.0 for Phase 1 AutoGrid")
+        return numeric
+
+    @field_validator("min_steps_per_sim_size")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_min_steps_per_sim_size(cls, value: float) -> float:
+        if float(value) < 1.0:
+            raise ValueError("min_steps_per_sim_size must be at least 1.0")
+        return _positive_float(value, field_name="min_steps_per_sim_size")
+
+    @field_validator("max_scale")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_max_scale(cls, value: float) -> float:
+        numeric = _positive_float(value, field_name="max_scale")
+        if numeric < 1.0:
+            raise ValueError("max_scale must be at least 1.0")
+        return numeric
+
+    @field_validator("dl_min")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_dl_min(cls, value: float | None) -> float | None:
+        if value is None:
+            return None
+        return _positive_float(value, field_name="dl_min")
+
+    def estimated_min_dl(self, *, wavelength: float, sim_size: Vec3) -> float:
+        """Return the Phase 1 vacuum-based lower bound for this AutoGrid."""
+        wavelength_dl = _positive_float(wavelength, field_name="wavelength") / self.min_steps_per_wvl
+        sim_dl = max(_positive_float(length, field_name="sim_size") for length in sim_size if length > 0.0)
+        sim_dl /= self.min_steps_per_sim_size
+        target = min(wavelength_dl, sim_dl)
+        if self.dl_min is not None:
+            target = max(target, self.dl_min)
+        return target
+
+    def make_boundaries(
+        self,
+        *,
+        center: float,
+        size: float,
+        wavelength: float,
+        sim_size: Vec3,
+        layer_refinement_specs: Iterable[LayerRefinementSpec] = (),
+    ) -> tuple[float, ...]:
+        """Resolve a simplified AutoGrid axis with optional layer refinement metadata."""
+        axis_min, axis_max = _normalize_axis_bounds(center=center, size=size)
+        tolerance = max(1e-12, abs(size) * 1e-9)
+        if math.isclose(axis_min, axis_max, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=tolerance):
+            return (axis_min, axis_max)
+
+        base_dl = self.estimated_min_dl(wavelength=wavelength, sim_size=sim_size)
+        regions: list[tuple[float, float, float]] = []
+        snapping_points = {axis_min, axis_max}
+
+        for spec in layer_refinement_specs:
+            lower, upper = spec.axis_bounds()
+            clipped_lower = max(axis_min, lower)
+            clipped_upper = min(axis_max, upper)
+            if clipped_upper < axis_min - tolerance or clipped_lower > axis_max + tolerance:
+                continue
+
+            target_dl = spec.target_dl(base_dl=base_dl)
+            if target_dl is not None and clipped_upper - clipped_lower > tolerance:
+                regions.append((clipped_lower, clipped_upper, target_dl))
+
+            if spec.bounds_refinement is not None:
+                boundary_dl = spec.bounds_refinement.effective_dl(vacuum_dl=base_dl)
+                half_width = boundary_dl * spec.bounds_refinement.num_cells / 2.0
+                for point in spec.snapping_points():
+                    snapped = _snap_to_axis(
+                        point, axis_min=axis_min, axis_max=axis_max, tolerance=tolerance
+                    )
+                    if snapped is None:
+                        continue
+                    snapping_points.add(snapped)
+                    regions.append(
+                        (
+                            max(axis_min, snapped - half_width),
+                            min(axis_max, snapped + half_width),
+                            boundary_dl,
+                        )
+                    )
+            else:
+                for point in spec.snapping_points():
+                    snapped = _snap_to_axis(
+                        point, axis_min=axis_min, axis_max=axis_max, tolerance=tolerance
+                    )
+                    if snapped is not None:
+                        snapping_points.add(snapped)
+
+        breakpoints = sorted(snapping_points | {start for start, _, _ in regions} | {end for _, end, _ in regions})
+        boundaries = [axis_min]
+        for segment_start, segment_end in zip(breakpoints, breakpoints[1:], strict=False):
+            if math.isclose(segment_start, segment_end, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=tolerance):
+                continue
+            midpoint = (segment_start + segment_end) / 2.0
+            target_dl = min(
+                (dl for start, end, dl in regions if start - tolerance <= midpoint <= end + tolerance),
+                default=base_dl,
+            )
+            num_cells = max(1, math.ceil((segment_end - segment_start) / target_dl))
+            snapped_dl = (segment_end - segment_start) / num_cells
+            for index in range(1, num_cells + 1):
+                boundaries.append(segment_start + snapped_dl * index)
+
+        graded = self._enforce_max_scale(boundaries, tolerance=tolerance)
+        return _deduplicate_coords(graded, tolerance=tolerance)
+
+    def _enforce_max_scale(self, boundaries: list[float], *, tolerance: float) -> list[float]:
+        if len(boundaries) < 3 or self.max_scale <= 1.0:
+            return boundaries
+
+        graded = list(boundaries)
+        changed = True
+        while changed:
+            changed = False
+            cell_sizes = [upper - lower for lower, upper in zip(graded, graded[1:], strict=False)]
+            for index in range(len(cell_sizes) - 1):
+                left = cell_sizes[index]
+                right = cell_sizes[index + 1]
+                if left <= tolerance or right <= tolerance:
+                    continue
+                ratio = max(left, right) / min(left, right)
+                if ratio <= self.max_scale + 1e-12:
+                    continue
+                if left > right:
+                    graded.insert(index + 1, (graded[index] + graded[index + 1]) / 2.0)
+                else:
+                    graded.insert(index + 2, (graded[index + 1] + graded[index + 2]) / 2.0)
+                changed = True
+                break
+        return graded
+

# Phase 1 Maxwell Solver Loop Working Memory

Use this file for cumulative findings, reusable facts, decisions, and cross-task notes.

Keep it concise. Do not repeat information already captured in `loop.prompt.md` or other local files.
Prefer referencing local file paths and distilled takeaways instead of copying long excerpts.

Suggested sections:

- Facts
- Decisions
- Open Questions
- Reusable References
- Task Handoffs

## Facts

- `task-001` starts from an effectively empty repo with no `src/` package or tooling.
- `phase1/feature-checklist.md` is now mirrored in code via `src/autofdtd/planning.py` so later tasks can reuse a local feature/status source instead of reparsing markdown.
- `src/autofdtd/core/containers.py` now holds the first frozen tagged container models for `Structure`, `Scene`, and `Simulation`; `src/autofdtd/api/simulation.py` re-exports them as the public API surface.
- `src/autofdtd/ir/models.py` now defines the first versioned execution IR, with `ComponentIR`, `StructureIR`, `SceneIR`, `SimulationIR`, and `ExecutionPackageIR` as the transport contract.
- `src/autofdtd/core/validation.py` now centralizes Phase 1 normalization rules, unsupported-feature checks, primitive geometry sanity checks, simulation-bound checks, and zero-dimension boundary coercion.
- `src/autofdtd/core/models.py` now provides the shared frozen model contract with `model_tag()`, `copy_update()`, `json_ready()`, and stable JSON serialization helpers reused by both public containers and IR models.
- `src/autofdtd/geometry/primitives.py` now provides typed `Box`, `Sphere`, and `Cylinder` public models plus `GeometryTransform`, bounds, point-containment, and translation helpers.
- `src/autofdtd/ir/models.py` now lowers primitive geometries into typed `BoxIR`, `SphereIR`, and `CylinderIR` payloads with explicit bounds and scene-compilation transform metadata.
- `src/autofdtd/geometry/polyslab.py` now provides a typed `PolySlab` model for simple-polygon extrusions with bounds, containment, translation, and simple-polygon validation; `src/autofdtd/ir/models.py` lowers it into `PolySlabIR`.
- `src/autofdtd/geometry/composite.py` now provides `GeometryGroup`, `Transformed`, `GeometryArray`, and a narrow `ClipOperation` subset (`union`, `intersection`, `difference`) for Phase 1 scene construction.
- `GeometryTransform` now supports explicit rigid-transform composition plus translation, rotation, reflection, and conservative transformed-bounds evaluation for wrapper lowering and scene queries.
- `src/autofdtd/ir/models.py` now carries typed wrapper IR via `GeometryGroupIR`, `TransformedIR`, and `ClipOperationIR`.
- `GeometryArray` uses Tidy3D-style `geometry + offsets + transforms` public semantics, but Phase 1 keeps transforms rigid and linear-only and lowers arrays into explicit grouped instances for IR and overlap evaluation.
- `Scene.structure_precedence()` and `Scene.resolve_structure_stack_at_point()` now expose concrete overlap order with `source_index`, `resolved_priority`, and `precedence_rank`, and `StructureIR` carries the same metadata for later compiler stages.
- `src/autofdtd/grid/specs.py` now provides Phase 1 `UniformGrid`, `CustomGrid`, `CustomGridBoundaries`, `GridSpec`, and `ResolvedGrid` models; `Simulation.resolved_grid()` validates and resolves manual discretization against the simulation domain.
- `src/autofdtd/ir/models.py` now lowers `GridSpec` into typed grid IR with per-axis spec payloads plus resolved boundary and shape metadata, so later compiler work can consume inspectable discretization state instead of reparsing public models.

## Decisions

- Reserve subsystem namespaces now: `api`, `core`, `geometry`, `materials`, `boundaries`, `sources`, `monitors`, `grid`, `modes`, `ir`, `compiler`, `runtime`, `kernels`, `diagnostics`, `examples`.
- Use `hatchling` with a `src/` layout and ship a small CLI (`autofdtd-feature-matrix`) so the scaffold has a concrete install/runtime smoke target before solver code exists.
- Keep this task focused on packaging, docs, and planning metadata; full tagged models remain for `task-002` and `task-003`.
- Model ordered overlap explicitly through `Scene.structures_in_resolution_order()`, sorting by resolved priority and then insertion order so later structures still win ties during sequential materialization.
- Keep the initial container layer serialization-light: `to_payload()`, `to_json_text()`, and `write_json()` are enough for snapshots and handoff, while `task-005` can generalize the shared model base.
- Use a generic family-tagged component envelope in the IR so Phase 1 can package realistic simulations before every feature family has concrete typed IR classes; later tasks can specialize payloads without changing bundle shape.
- Bundle packaging is directory-based: `manifest.json` points at a hashed `simulation.json` entrypoint, avoiding self-referential manifest hashing while staying suitable for remote upload or local caching.
- Core validation is checklist-driven: implemented feature tags pass, deferred or rejected tags fail early with explicit errors, and known primitive geometry payloads validate only when enough fields are present so placeholder tagged dicts can survive until their concrete family tasks land.
- Shared model behavior should live in `autofdtd.core.models`; public API and IR classes should subclass it rather than duplicating serialization or copy helpers in subsystem-local base classes.
- Primitive geometry stays axis-aligned in Phase 1 public models; scene-compilation transforms are still explicit so later `Transformed` and grouped-geometry tasks can lower onto the same contract instead of rewriting primitive handling.
- Structure precedence is now inspectable with `Scene.resolve_structure_at_point()`, which mirrors materialization order by applying primitive containment checks in resolved-priority order.
- Keep `GeometryArray` as a public wrapper only; repeated placements lower into ordinary grouped and transformed instances so runtime/compiler code can treat arrays as pre-expanded ordered geometry.
- Phase 1 `PolySlab` scope is intentionally limited to constant-cross-section extrusions of simple polygons on principal axes; non-zero `dilation` or `sidewall_angle`, self-intersections, and curved or boolean polygon features must fail explicitly until later geometry tasks land.
- Keep the feature ledger conservative for clipping: `ClipOperation` remains a deferred family in `planning.py`, but geometry validation explicitly allows the implemented subset and rejects unsupported boolean ops with clear errors.
- Phase 1 transform wrappers are rigid only; free-form affine matrices and exact boolean meshing remain out of scope even though the public model now supports grouped and transformed composition.
- Keep the top-level simulation grid surface strict: `grid_spec` must be a `GridSpec`, manual axis specs resolve immediately, and planned `AutoGrid` or refinement families should fail explicitly until their dedicated task lands.

## Task Handoffs

- `task-003` should add versioned IR models under `autofdtd.ir` without coupling them to the public API module layout; it can treat `Simulation.to_payload()` as an interim handoff format, not the final IR contract.
- Later geometry, material, source, and monitor tasks can plug concrete tagged models into the existing container fields without changing the ordered-container semantics.
- `task-004` and `task-005` can reuse `ComponentIR.payload` plus the shared IR schema version constants instead of inventing another transport shape.
- Later geometry, source, monitor, boundary, and grid tasks should route new object models through `autofdtd.core.validation.normalize_component()` or extend its equivalents instead of scattering policy checks across each family.
- Later compiler work can rely on wrapper IR bounds as conservative planning envelopes; exact voxelization or boolean rasterization still belongs in scene compilation rather than the public geometry layer.
- Later compiler work can consume `StructureIR.source_index` plus `StructureIR.precedence_rank` directly when building ordered region materialization plans or conflict diagnostics.

+def _snap_to_axis(point: float, *, axis_min: float, axis_max: float, tolerance: float) -> float | None:
+    if point < axis_min - tolerance or point > axis_max + tolerance:
+        return None
+    if math.isclose(point, axis_min, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=tolerance):
+        return axis_min
+    if math.isclose(point, axis_max, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=tolerance):
+        return axis_max
+    return _finite_float(point, field_name="snapping point")
+
+
+def _axis_name_to_index(axis: AxisName | int) -> int:
+    if axis in (0, 1, 2):
+        return int(axis)
+    axis_map = {"x": 0, "y": 1, "z": 2}
+    if isinstance(axis, str) and axis.lower() in axis_map:
+        return axis_map[axis.lower()]
+    raise ValueError("axis must be one of 0, 1, 2, 'x', 'y', or 'z'")

+class GridRefinement(TaggedModel):
+    """Local refinement metadata for AutoGrid planning."""
+
+    type: Literal["GridRefinement"] = "GridRefinement"
+    refinement_factor: float | None = None
+    dl: float | None = None
+    num_cells: int = 3
+
+    @field_validator("refinement_factor")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_refinement_factor(cls, value: float | None) -> float | None:
+        if value is None:
+            return None
+        return _positive_float(value, field_name="refinement_factor")
+
+    @field_validator("dl")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_dl(cls, value: float | None) -> float | None:
+        if value is None:
+            return None
+        return _positive_float(value, field_name="dl")
+
+    @field_validator("num_cells")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_num_cells(cls, value: int) -> int:
+        return _positive_int(value, field_name="num_cells")
+
+    @property
+    def effective_refinement_factor(self) -> float | None:
+        """Return the refinement factor that should be applied in Phase 1."""
+        if self.refinement_factor is None and self.dl is None:
+            return _DEFAULT_REFINEMENT_FACTOR
+        return self.refinement_factor
+
+    def effective_dl(self, *, vacuum_dl: float) -> float:
+        """Return the smallest cell width requested by this refinement."""
+        base = _positive_float(vacuum_dl, field_name="vacuum_dl")
+        refined = math.inf
+        if self.effective_refinement_factor is not None:
+            refined = min(refined, base / self.effective_refinement_factor)
+        if self.dl is not None:
+            refined = min(refined, self.dl)
+        if not math.isfinite(refined):
+            raise ValueError("grid refinement could not determine a target dl")
+        return refined
+
+
+class LayerRefinementSpec(TaggedModel):
+    """Layer-aware AutoGrid refinement metadata with an explicit Phase 1 subset."""
+
+    type: Literal["LayerRefinementSpec"] = "LayerRefinementSpec"
+    axis: int
+    center: Vec3
+    size: Vec3
+    min_steps_along_axis: float | None = None
+    bounds_refinement: GridRefinement | None = None
+    bounds_snapping: Literal["bounds", "lower", "upper", "center"] | None = "lower"
+
+    @field_validator("axis")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_axis(cls, value: int) -> int:
+        return _axis_name_to_index(value)
+
+    @field_validator("center")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_center(cls, value: Vec3) -> Vec3:
+        return tuple(_finite_float(component, field_name="center") for component in value)
+
+    @field_validator("size")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_size(cls, value: Vec3) -> Vec3:
+        normalized = tuple(_finite_float(component, field_name="size") for component in value)
+        if any(component < 0.0 for component in normalized):
+            raise ValueError("size components must be non-negative")
+        return normalized
+
+    @field_validator("min_steps_along_axis")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_min_steps(cls, value: float | None) -> float | None:
+        if value is None:
+            return None
+        return _positive_float(value, field_name="min_steps_along_axis")
+
+    @property
+    def bounds(self) -> tuple[Vec3, Vec3]:
+        """Return axis-aligned layer bounds."""
+        lower = tuple(c - s / 2.0 for c, s in zip(self.center, self.size, strict=True))
+        upper = tuple(c + s / 2.0 for c, s in zip(self.center, self.size, strict=True))
+        return (lower, upper)
+
+    def axis_bounds(self) -> tuple[float, float]:
+        """Return the lower and upper coordinates along the normal axis."""
+        lower, upper = self.bounds
+        return (lower[self.axis], upper[self.axis])
+
+    def snapping_points(self) -> tuple[float, ...]:
+        """Return snapping points implied by the current layer configuration."""
+        lower, upper = self.axis_bounds()
+        center = self.center[self.axis]
+        mode = self.bounds_snapping
+        if mode is None:
+            return ()
+        if mode == "bounds":
+            return (lower, upper)
+        if mode == "lower":
+            return (lower,)
+        if mode == "upper":
+            return (upper,)
+        return (center,)
+
+    def target_dl(self, *, base_dl: float) -> float | None:
+        """Return the smallest requested dl inside the layer body, if any."""
+        target = math.inf
+        thickness = self.size[self.axis]
+        if self.min_steps_along_axis is not None and thickness > 0.0:
+            target = min(target, thickness / math.ceil(self.min_steps_along_axis))
+        if self.bounds_refinement is not None:
+            target = min(target, self.bounds_refinement.effective_dl(vacuum_dl=base_dl))
+        if not math.isfinite(target):
+            return None
+        return target
+
+
+class AutoGrid(TaggedModel):
+    """Simplified AutoGrid meshing policy with explicit Phase 1 limitations."""
+
+    type: Literal["AutoGrid"] = "AutoGrid"
+    min_steps_per_wvl: float = _DEFAULT_AUTOGRID_STEPS_PER_WVL
+    min_steps_per_sim_size: float = _DEFAULT_AUTOGRID_STEPS_PER_SIM_SIZE
+    max_scale: float = _DEFAULT_AUTOGRID_MAX_SCALE
+    dl_min: float | None = None
+
+    @field_validator("min_steps_per_wvl")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_min_steps_per_wvl(cls, value: float) -> float:
+        numeric = _positive_float(value, field_name="min_steps_per_wvl")
+        if numeric < 6.0:
+            raise ValueError("min_steps_per_wvl must be at least 6.0 for Phase 1 AutoGrid")
+        return numeric
+
+    @field_validator("min_steps_per_sim_size")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_min_steps_per_sim_size(cls, value: float) -> float:
+        if float(value) < 1.0:
+            raise ValueError("min_steps_per_sim_size must be at least 1.0")
+        return _positive_float(value, field_name="min_steps_per_sim_size")
+
+    @field_validator("max_scale")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_max_scale(cls, value: float) -> float:
+        numeric = _positive_float(value, field_name="max_scale")
+        if numeric < 1.0:
+            raise ValueError("max_scale must be at least 1.0")
+        return numeric
+
+    @field_validator("dl_min")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_dl_min(cls, value: float | None) -> float | None:
+        if value is None:
+            return None
+        return _positive_float(value, field_name="dl_min")
+
+    def estimated_min_dl(self, *, wavelength: float, sim_size: Vec3) -> float:
+        """Return the Phase 1 vacuum-based lower bound for this AutoGrid."""
+        wavelength_dl = _positive_float(wavelength, field_name="wavelength") / self.min_steps_per_wvl
+        sim_dl = max(_positive_float(length, field_name="sim_size") for length in sim_size if length > 0.0)
+        sim_dl /= self.min_steps_per_sim_size
+        target = min(wavelength_dl, sim_dl)
+        if self.dl_min is not None:
+            target = max(target, self.dl_min)
+        return target
+
+    def make_boundaries(
+        self,
+        *,
+        center: float,
+        size: float,
+        wavelength: float,
+        sim_size: Vec3,
+        layer_refinement_specs: Iterable[LayerRefinementSpec] = (),
+    ) -> tuple[float, ...]:
+        """Resolve a simplified AutoGrid axis with optional layer refinement metadata."""
+        axis_min, axis_max = _normalize_axis_bounds(center=center, size=size)
+        tolerance = max(1e-12, abs(size) * 1e-9)
+        if math.isclose(axis_min, axis_max, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=tolerance):
+            return (axis_min, axis_max)
+
+        base_dl = self.estimated_min_dl(wavelength=wavelength, sim_size=sim_size)
+        regions: list[tuple[float, float, float]] = []
+        snapping_points = {axis_min, axis_max}
+
+        for spec in layer_refinement_specs:
+            lower, upper = spec.axis_bounds()
+            clipped_lower = max(axis_min, lower)
+            clipped_upper = min(axis_max, upper)
+            if clipped_upper < axis_min - tolerance or clipped_lower > axis_max + tolerance:
+                continue
+
+            target_dl = spec.target_dl(base_dl=base_dl)
+            if target_dl is not None and clipped_upper - clipped_lower > tolerance:
+                regions.append((clipped_lower, clipped_upper, target_dl))
+
+            if spec.bounds_refinement is not None:
+                boundary_dl = spec.bounds_refinement.effective_dl(vacuum_dl=base_dl)
+                half_width = boundary_dl * spec.bounds_refinement.num_cells / 2.0
+                for point in spec.snapping_points():
+                    snapped = _snap_to_axis(
+                        point, axis_min=axis_min, axis_max=axis_max, tolerance=tolerance
+                    )
+                    if snapped is None:
+                        continue
+                    snapping_points.add(snapped)
+                    regions.append(
+                        (
+                            max(axis_min, snapped - half_width),
+                            min(axis_max, snapped + half_width),
+                            boundary_dl,
+                        )
+                    )
+            else:
+                for point in spec.snapping_points():
+                    snapped = _snap_to_axis(
+                        point, axis_min=axis_min, axis_max=axis_max, tolerance=tolerance
+                    )
+                    if snapped is not None:
+                        snapping_points.add(snapped)
+
+        breakpoints = sorted(snapping_points | {start for start, _, _ in regions} | {end for _, end, _ in regions})
+        boundaries = [axis_min]
+        for segment_start, segment_end in zip(breakpoints, breakpoints[1:], strict=False):
+            if math.isclose(segment_start, segment_end, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=tolerance):
+                continue
+            midpoint = (segment_start + segment_end) / 2.0
+            target_dl = min(
+                (dl for start, end, dl in regions if start - tolerance <= midpoint <= end + tolerance),
+                default=base_dl,
+            )
+            num_cells = max(1, math.ceil((segment_end - segment_start) / target_dl))
+            snapped_dl = (segment_end - segment_start) / num_cells
+            for index in range(1, num_cells + 1):
+                boundaries.append(segment_start + snapped_dl * index)
+
+        graded = self._enforce_max_scale(boundaries, tolerance=tolerance)
+        return _deduplicate_coords(graded, tolerance=tolerance)
+
+    def _enforce_max_scale(self, boundaries: list[float], *, tolerance: float) -> list[float]:
+        if len(boundaries) < 3 or self.max_scale <= 1.0:
+            return boundaries
+
+        graded = list(boundaries)
+        changed = True
+        while changed:
+            changed = False
+            cell_sizes = [upper - lower for lower, upper in zip(graded, graded[1:], strict=False)]
+            for index in range(len(cell_sizes) - 1):
+                left = cell_sizes[index]
+                right = cell_sizes[index + 1]
+                if left <= tolerance or right <= tolerance:
+                    continue
+                ratio = max(left, right) / min(left, right)
+                if ratio <= self.max_scale + 1e-12:
+                    continue
+                if left > right:
+                    graded.insert(index + 1, (graded[index] + graded[index + 1]) / 2.0)
+                else:
+                    graded.insert(index + 2, (graded[index + 1] + graded[index + 2]) / 2.0)
+                changed = True
+                break
+        return graded
+

 AxisGridSpec = Annotated[

+def _snap_to_axis(point: float, *, axis_min: float, axis_max: float, tolerance: float) -> float | None:
+    if point < axis_min - tolerance or point > axis_max + tolerance:
+        return None
+    if math.isclose(point, axis_min, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=tolerance):
+        return axis_min
+    if math.isclose(point, axis_max, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=tolerance):
+        return axis_max
+    return _finite_float(point, field_name="snapping point")
+
+
+def _axis_name_to_index(axis: AxisName | int) -> int:
+    if axis in (0, 1, 2):
+        return int(axis)
+    axis_map = {"x": 0, "y": 1, "z": 2}
+    if isinstance(axis, str) and axis.lower() in axis_map:
+        return axis_map[axis.lower()]
+    raise ValueError("axis must be one of 0, 1, 2, 'x', 'y', or 'z'")
