+class GridRefinement(TaggedModel):
+    """Local refinement metadata for AutoGrid planning."""
+
+    type: Literal["GridRefinement"] = "GridRefinement"
+    refinement_factor: float | None = None
+    dl: float | None = None
+    num_cells: int = 3
+
+    @field_validator("refinement_factor")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_refinement_factor(cls, value: float | None) -> float | None:
+        if value is None:
+            return None
+        return _positive_float(value, field_name="refinement_factor")
+
+    @field_validator("dl")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_dl(cls, value: float | None) -> float | None:
+        if value is None:
+            return None
+        return _positive_float(value, field_name="dl")
+
+    @field_validator("num_cells")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_num_cells(cls, value: int) -> int:
+        return _positive_int(value, field_name="num_cells")
+
+    @property
+    def effective_refinement_factor(self) -> float | None:
+        """Return the refinement factor that should be applied in Phase 1."""
+        if self.refinement_factor is None and self.dl is None:
+            return _DEFAULT_REFINEMENT_FACTOR
+        return self.refinement_factor
+
+    def effective_dl(self, *, vacuum_dl: float) -> float:
+        """Return the smallest cell width requested by this refinement."""
+        base = _positive_float(vacuum_dl, field_name="vacuum_dl")
+        refined = math.inf
+        if self.effective_refinement_factor is not None:
+            refined = min(refined, base / self.effective_refinement_factor)
+        if self.dl is not None:
+            refined = min(refined, self.dl)
+        if not math.isfinite(refined):
+            raise ValueError("grid refinement could not determine a target dl")
+        return refined
+
+
+class LayerRefinementSpec(TaggedModel):
+    """Layer-aware AutoGrid refinement metadata with an explicit Phase 1 subset."""
+
+    type: Literal["LayerRefinementSpec"] = "LayerRefinementSpec"
+    axis: int
+    center: Vec3
+    size: Vec3
+    min_steps_along_axis: float | None = None
+    bounds_refinement: GridRefinement | None = None
+    bounds_snapping: Literal["bounds", "lower", "upper", "center"] | None = "lower"
+
+    @field_validator("axis")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_axis(cls, value: int) -> int:
+        return _axis_name_to_index(value)
+
+    @field_validator("center")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_center(cls, value: Vec3) -> Vec3:
+        return tuple(_finite_float(component, field_name="center") for component in value)
+
+    @field_validator("size")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_size(cls, value: Vec3) -> Vec3:
+        normalized = tuple(_finite_float(component, field_name="size") for component in value)
+        if any(component < 0.0 for component in normalized):
+            raise ValueError("size components must be non-negative")
+        return normalized
+
+    @field_validator("min_steps_along_axis")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_min_steps(cls, value: float | None) -> float | None:
+        if value is None:
+            return None
+        return _positive_float(value, field_name="min_steps_along_axis")
+
+    @property
+    def bounds(self) -> tuple[Vec3, Vec3]:
+        """Return axis-aligned layer bounds."""
+        lower = tuple(c - s / 2.0 for c, s in zip(self.center, self.size, strict=True))
+        upper = tuple(c + s / 2.0 for c, s in zip(self.center, self.size, strict=True))
+        return (lower, upper)
+
+    def axis_bounds(self) -> tuple[float, float]:
+        """Return the lower and upper coordinates along the normal axis."""
+        lower, upper = self.bounds
+        return (lower[self.axis], upper[self.axis])
+
+    def snapping_points(self) -> tuple[float, ...]:
+        """Return snapping points implied by the current layer configuration."""
+        lower, upper = self.axis_bounds()
+        center = self.center[self.axis]
+        mode = self.bounds_snapping
+        if mode is None:
+            return ()
+        if mode == "bounds":
+            return (lower, upper)
+        if mode == "lower":
+            return (lower,)
+        if mode == "upper":
+            return (upper,)
+        return (center,)
+
+    def target_dl(self, *, base_dl: float) -> float | None:
+        """Return the smallest requested dl inside the layer body, if any."""
+        target = math.inf
+        thickness = self.size[self.axis]
+        if self.min_steps_along_axis is not None and thickness > 0.0:
+            target = min(target, thickness / math.ceil(self.min_steps_along_axis))
+        if self.bounds_refinement is not None:
+            target = min(target, self.bounds_refinement.effective_dl(vacuum_dl=base_dl))
+        if not math.isfinite(target):
+            return None
+        return target
+
+
+class AutoGrid(TaggedModel):
+    """Simplified AutoGrid meshing policy with explicit Phase 1 limitations."""
+
+    type: Literal["AutoGrid"] = "AutoGrid"
+    min_steps_per_wvl: float = _DEFAULT_AUTOGRID_STEPS_PER_WVL
+    min_steps_per_sim_size: float = _DEFAULT_AUTOGRID_STEPS_PER_SIM_SIZE
+    max_scale: float = _DEFAULT_AUTOGRID_MAX_SCALE
+    dl_min: float | None = None
+
+    @field_validator("min_steps_per_wvl")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_min_steps_per_wvl(cls, value: float) -> float:
+        numeric = _positive_float(value, field_name="min_steps_per_wvl")
+        if numeric < 6.0:
+            raise ValueError("min_steps_per_wvl must be at least 6.0 for Phase 1 AutoGrid")
+        return numeric
+
+    @field_validator("min_steps_per_sim_size")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_min_steps_per_sim_size(cls, value: float) -> float:
+        if float(value) < 1.0:
+            raise ValueError("min_steps_per_sim_size must be at least 1.0")
+        return _positive_float(value, field_name="min_steps_per_sim_size")
+
+    @field_validator("max_scale")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_max_scale(cls, value: float) -> float:
+        numeric = _positive_float(value, field_name="max_scale")
+        if numeric < 1.0:
+            raise ValueError("max_scale must be at least 1.0")
+        return numeric
+
+    @field_validator("dl_min")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_dl_min(cls, value: float | None) -> float | None:
+        if value is None:
+            return None
+        return _positive_float(value, field_name="dl_min")
+
+    def estimated_min_dl(self, *, wavelength: float, sim_size: Vec3) -> float:
+        """Return the Phase 1 vacuum-based lower bound for this AutoGrid."""
+        wavelength_dl = _positive_float(wavelength, field_name="wavelength") / self.min_steps_per_wvl
+        sim_dl = max(_positive_float(length, field_name="sim_size") for length in sim_size if length > 0.0)
+        sim_dl /= self.min_steps_per_sim_size
+        target = min(wavelength_dl, sim_dl)
+        if self.dl_min is not None:
+            target = max(target, self.dl_min)
+        return target
+
+    def make_boundaries(
+        self,
+        *,
+        center: float,
+        size: float,
+        wavelength: float,
+        sim_size: Vec3,
+        layer_refinement_specs: Iterable[LayerRefinementSpec] = (),
+    ) -> tuple[float, ...]:
+        """Resolve a simplified AutoGrid axis with optional layer refinement metadata."""
+        axis_min, axis_max = _normalize_axis_bounds(center=center, size=size)
+        tolerance = max(1e-12, abs(size) * 1e-9)
+        if math.isclose(axis_min, axis_max, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=tolerance):
+            return (axis_min, axis_max)
+
+        base_dl = self.estimated_min_dl(wavelength=wavelength, sim_size=sim_size)
+        regions: list[tuple[float, float, float]] = []
+        snapping_points = {axis_min, axis_max}
+
+        for spec in layer_refinement_specs:
+            lower, upper = spec.axis_bounds()
+            clipped_lower = max(axis_min, lower)
+            clipped_upper = min(axis_max, upper)
+            if clipped_upper < axis_min - tolerance or clipped_lower > axis_max + tolerance:
+                continue
+
+            target_dl = spec.target_dl(base_dl=base_dl)
+            if target_dl is not None and clipped_upper - clipped_lower > tolerance:
+                regions.append((clipped_lower, clipped_upper, target_dl))
+
+            if spec.bounds_refinement is not None:
+                boundary_dl = spec.bounds_refinement.effective_dl(vacuum_dl=base_dl)
+                half_width = boundary_dl * spec.bounds_refinement.num_cells / 2.0
+                for point in spec.snapping_points():
+                    snapped = _snap_to_axis(
+                        point, axis_min=axis_min, axis_max=axis_max, tolerance=tolerance
+                    )
+                    if snapped is None:
+                        continue
+                    snapping_points.add(snapped)
+                    regions.append(
+                        (
+                            max(axis_min, snapped - half_width),
+                            min(axis_max, snapped + half_width),
+                            boundary_dl,
+                        )
+                    )
+            else:
+                for point in spec.snapping_points():
+                    snapped = _snap_to_axis(
+                        point, axis_min=axis_min, axis_max=axis_max, tolerance=tolerance
+                    )
+                    if snapped is not None:
+                        snapping_points.add(snapped)
+
+        breakpoints = sorted(snapping_points | {start for start, _, _ in regions} | {end for _, end, _ in regions})
+        boundaries = [axis_min]
+        for segment_start, segment_end in zip(breakpoints, breakpoints[1:], strict=False):
+            if math.isclose(segment_start, segment_end, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=tolerance):
+                continue
+            midpoint = (segment_start + segment_end) / 2.0
+            target_dl = min(
+                (dl for start, end, dl in regions if start - tolerance <= midpoint <= end + tolerance),
+                default=base_dl,
+            )
+            num_cells = max(1, math.ceil((segment_end - segment_start) / target_dl))
+            snapped_dl = (segment_end - segment_start) / num_cells
+            for index in range(1, num_cells + 1):
+                boundaries.append(segment_start + snapped_dl * index)
+
+        graded = self._enforce_max_scale(boundaries, tolerance=tolerance)
+        return _deduplicate_coords(graded, tolerance=tolerance)
+
+    def _enforce_max_scale(self, boundaries: list[float], *, tolerance: float) -> list[float]:
+        if len(boundaries) < 3 or self.max_scale <= 1.0:
+            return boundaries
+
+        graded = list(boundaries)
+        changed = True
+        while changed:
+            changed = False
+            cell_sizes = [upper - lower for lower, upper in zip(graded, graded[1:], strict=False)]
+            for index in range(len(cell_sizes) - 1):
+                left = cell_sizes[index]
+                right = cell_sizes[index + 1]
+                if left <= tolerance or right <= tolerance:
+                    continue
+                ratio = max(left, right) / min(left, right)
+                if ratio <= self.max_scale + 1e-12:
+                    continue
+                if left > right:
+                    graded.insert(index + 1, (graded[index] + graded[index + 1]) / 2.0)
+                else:
+                    graded.insert(index + 2, (graded[index + 1] + graded[index + 2]) / 2.0)
+                changed = True
+                break
+        return graded
+

+def _snap_to_axis(point: float, *, axis_min: float, axis_max: float, tolerance: float) -> float | None:
+    if point < axis_min - tolerance or point > axis_max + tolerance:
+        return None
+    if math.isclose(point, axis_min, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=tolerance):
+        return axis_min
+    if math.isclose(point, axis_max, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=tolerance):
+        return axis_max
+    return _finite_float(point, field_name="snapping point")
+
+
+def _axis_name_to_index(axis: AxisName | int) -> int:
+    if axis in (0, 1, 2):
+        return int(axis)
+    axis_map = {"x": 0, "y": 1, "z": 2}
+    if isinstance(axis, str) and axis.lower() in axis_map:
+        return axis_map[axis.lower()]
+    raise ValueError("axis must be one of 0, 1, 2, 'x', 'y', or 'z'")

+class GridRefinement(TaggedModel):
+    """Local refinement metadata for AutoGrid planning."""
+
+    type: Literal["GridRefinement"] = "GridRefinement"
+    refinement_factor: float | None = None
+    dl: float | None = None
+    num_cells: int = 3
+
+    @field_validator("refinement_factor")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_refinement_factor(cls, value: float | None) -> float | None:
+        if value is None:
+            return None
+        return _positive_float(value, field_name="refinement_factor")
+
+    @field_validator("dl")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_dl(cls, value: float | None) -> float | None:
+        if value is None:
+            return None
+        return _positive_float(value, field_name="dl")
+
+    @field_validator("num_cells")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_num_cells(cls, value: int) -> int:
+        return _positive_int(value, field_name="num_cells")
+
+    @property
+    def effective_refinement_factor(self) -> float | None:
+        """Return the refinement factor that should be applied in Phase 1."""
+        if self.refinement_factor is None and self.dl is None:
+            return _DEFAULT_REFINEMENT_FACTOR
+        return self.refinement_factor
+
+    def effective_dl(self, *, vacuum_dl: float) -> float:
+        """Return the smallest cell width requested by this refinement."""
+        base = _positive_float(vacuum_dl, field_name="vacuum_dl")
+        refined = math.inf
+        if self.effective_refinement_factor is not None:
+            refined = min(refined, base / self.effective_refinement_factor)
+        if self.dl is not None:
+            refined = min(refined, self.dl)
+        if not math.isfinite(refined):
+            raise ValueError("grid refinement could not determine a target dl")
+        return refined
+
+
+class LayerRefinementSpec(TaggedModel):
+    """Layer-aware AutoGrid refinement metadata with an explicit Phase 1 subset."""
+
+    type: Literal["LayerRefinementSpec"] = "LayerRefinementSpec"
+    axis: int
+    center: Vec3
+    size: Vec3
+    min_steps_along_axis: float | None = None
+    bounds_refinement: GridRefinement | None = None
+    bounds_snapping: Literal["bounds", "lower", "upper", "center"] | None = "lower"
+
+    @field_validator("axis")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_axis(cls, value: int) -> int:
+        return _axis_name_to_index(value)
+
+    @field_validator("center")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_center(cls, value: Vec3) -> Vec3:
+        return tuple(_finite_float(component, field_name="center") for component in value)
+
+    @field_validator("size")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_size(cls, value: Vec3) -> Vec3:
+        normalized = tuple(_finite_float(component, field_name="size") for component in value)
+        if any(component < 0.0 for component in normalized):
+            raise ValueError("size components must be non-negative")
+        return normalized
+
+    @field_validator("min_steps_along_axis")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_min_steps(cls, value: float | None) -> float | None:
+        if value is None:
+            return None
+        return _positive_float(value, field_name="min_steps_along_axis")
+
+    @property
+    def bounds(self) -> tuple[Vec3, Vec3]:
+        """Return axis-aligned layer bounds."""
+        lower = tuple(c - s / 2.0 for c, s in zip(self.center, self.size, strict=True))
+        upper = tuple(c + s / 2.0 for c, s in zip(self.center, self.size, strict=True))
+        return (lower, upper)
+
+    def axis_bounds(self) -> tuple[float, float]:
+        """Return the lower and upper coordinates along the normal axis."""
+        lower, upper = self.bounds
+        return (lower[self.axis], upper[self.axis])
+
+    def snapping_points(self) -> tuple[float, ...]:
+        """Return snapping points implied by the current layer configuration."""
+        lower, upper = self.axis_bounds()
+        center = self.center[self.axis]
+        mode = self.bounds_snapping
+        if mode is None:
+            return ()
+        if mode == "bounds":
+            return (lower, upper)
+        if mode == "lower":
+            return (lower,)
+        if mode == "upper":
+            return (upper,)
+        return (center,)
+
+    def target_dl(self, *, base_dl: float) -> float | None:
+        """Return the smallest requested dl inside the layer body, if any."""
+        target = math.inf
+        thickness = self.size[self.axis]
+        if self.min_steps_along_axis is not None and thickness > 0.0:
+            target = min(target, thickness / math.ceil(self.min_steps_along_axis))
+        if self.bounds_refinement is not None:
+            target = min(target, self.bounds_refinement.effective_dl(vacuum_dl=base_dl))
+        if not math.isfinite(target):
+            return None
+        return target
+
+
+class AutoGrid(TaggedModel):
+    """Simplified AutoGrid meshing policy with explicit Phase 1 limitations."""
+
+    type: Literal["AutoGrid"] = "AutoGrid"
+    min_steps_per_wvl: float = _DEFAULT_AUTOGRID_STEPS_PER_WVL
+    min_steps_per_sim_size: float = _DEFAULT_AUTOGRID_STEPS_PER_SIM_SIZE
+    max_scale: float = _DEFAULT_AUTOGRID_MAX_SCALE
+    dl_min: float | None = None
+
+    @field_validator("min_steps_per_wvl")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_min_steps_per_wvl(cls, value: float) -> float:
+        numeric = _positive_float(value, field_name="min_steps_per_wvl")
+        if numeric < 6.0:
+            raise ValueError("min_steps_per_wvl must be at least 6.0 for Phase 1 AutoGrid")
+        return numeric
+
+    @field_validator("min_steps_per_sim_size")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_min_steps_per_sim_size(cls, value: float) -> float:
+        if float(value) < 1.0:
+            raise ValueError("min_steps_per_sim_size must be at least 1.0")
+        return _positive_float(value, field_name="min_steps_per_sim_size")
+
+    @field_validator("max_scale")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_max_scale(cls, value: float) -> float:
+        numeric = _positive_float(value, field_name="max_scale")
+        if numeric < 1.0:
+            raise ValueError("max_scale must be at least 1.0")
+        return numeric
+
+    @field_validator("dl_min")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_dl_min(cls, value: float | None) -> float | None:
+        if value is None:
+            return None
+        return _positive_float(value, field_name="dl_min")
+
+    def estimated_min_dl(self, *, wavelength: float, sim_size: Vec3) -> float:
+        """Return the Phase 1 vacuum-based lower bound for this AutoGrid."""
+        wavelength_dl = _positive_float(wavelength, field_name="wavelength") / self.min_steps_per_wvl
+        sim_dl = max(_positive_float(length, field_name="sim_size") for length in sim_size if length > 0.0)
+        sim_dl /= self.min_steps_per_sim_size
+        target = min(wavelength_dl, sim_dl)
+        if self.dl_min is not None:
+            target = max(target, self.dl_min)
+        return target
+
+    def make_boundaries(
+        self,
+        *,
+        center: float,
+        size: float,
+        wavelength: float,
+        sim_size: Vec3,
+        layer_refinement_specs: Iterable[LayerRefinementSpec] = (),
+    ) -> tuple[float, ...]:
+        """Resolve a simplified AutoGrid axis with optional layer refinement metadata."""
+        axis_min, axis_max = _normalize_axis_bounds(center=center, size=size)
+        tolerance = max(1e-12, abs(size) * 1e-9)
+        if math.isclose(axis_min, axis_max, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=tolerance):
+            return (axis_min, axis_max)
+
+        base_dl = self.estimated_min_dl(wavelength=wavelength, sim_size=sim_size)
+        regions: list[tuple[float, float, float]] = []
+        snapping_points = {axis_min, axis_max}
+
+        for spec in layer_refinement_specs:
+            lower, upper = spec.axis_bounds()
+            clipped_lower = max(axis_min, lower)
+            clipped_upper = min(axis_max, upper)
+            if clipped_upper < axis_min - tolerance or clipped_lower > axis_max + tolerance:
+                continue
+
+            target_dl = spec.target_dl(base_dl=base_dl)
+            if target_dl is not None and clipped_upper - clipped_lower > tolerance:
+                regions.append((clipped_lower, clipped_upper, target_dl))
+
+            if spec.bounds_refinement is not None:
+                boundary_dl = spec.bounds_refinement.effective_dl(vacuum_dl=base_dl)
+                half_width = boundary_dl * spec.bounds_refinement.num_cells / 2.0
+                for point in spec.snapping_points():
+                    snapped = _snap_to_axis(
+                        point, axis_min=axis_min, axis_max=axis_max, tolerance=tolerance
+                    )
+                    if snapped is None:
+                        continue
+                    snapping_points.add(snapped)
+                    regions.append(
+                        (
+                            max(axis_min, snapped - half_width),
+                            min(axis_max, snapped + half_width),
+                            boundary_dl,
+                        )
+                    )
+            else:
+                for point in spec.snapping_points():
+                    snapped = _snap_to_axis(
+                        point, axis_min=axis_min, axis_max=axis_max, tolerance=tolerance
+                    )
+                    if snapped is not None:
+                        snapping_points.add(snapped)
+
+        breakpoints = sorted(snapping_points | {start for start, _, _ in regions} | {end for _, end, _ in regions})
+        boundaries = [axis_min]
+        for segment_start, segment_end in zip(breakpoints, breakpoints[1:], strict=False):
+            if math.isclose(segment_start, segment_end, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=tolerance):
+                continue
+            midpoint = (segment_start + segment_end) / 2.0
+            target_dl = min(
+                (dl for start, end, dl in regions if start - tolerance <= midpoint <= end + tolerance),
+                default=base_dl,
+            )
+            num_cells = max(1, math.ceil((segment_end - segment_start) / target_dl))
+            snapped_dl = (segment_end - segment_start) / num_cells
+            for index in range(1, num_cells + 1):
+                boundaries.append(segment_start + snapped_dl * index)
+
+        graded = self._enforce_max_scale(boundaries, tolerance=tolerance)
+        return _deduplicate_coords(graded, tolerance=tolerance)
+
+    def _enforce_max_scale(self, boundaries: list[float], *, tolerance: float) -> list[float]:
+        if len(boundaries) < 3 or self.max_scale <= 1.0:
+            return boundaries
+
+        graded = list(boundaries)
+        changed = True
+        while changed:
+            changed = False
+            cell_sizes = [upper - lower for lower, upper in zip(graded, graded[1:], strict=False)]
+            for index in range(len(cell_sizes) - 1):
+                left = cell_sizes[index]
+                right = cell_sizes[index + 1]
+                if left <= tolerance or right <= tolerance:
+                    continue
+                ratio = max(left, right) / min(left, right)
+                if ratio <= self.max_scale + 1e-12:
+                    continue
+                if left > right:
+                    graded.insert(index + 1, (graded[index] + graded[index + 1]) / 2.0)
+                else:
+                    graded.insert(index + 2, (graded[index + 1] + graded[index + 2]) / 2.0)
+                changed = True
+                break
+        return graded
+

+## Facts
+
+- `task-001` starts from an effectively empty repo with no `src/` package or tooling.
+- `phase1/feature-checklist.md` is now mirrored in code via `src/autofdtd/planning.py` so later tasks can reuse a local feature/status source instead of reparsing markdown.
+- `src/autofdtd/core/containers.py` now holds the first frozen tagged container models for `Structure`, `Scene`, and `Simulation`; `src/autofdtd/api/simulation.py` re-exports them as the public API surface.
+- `src/autofdtd/ir/models.py` now defines the first versioned execution IR, with `ComponentIR`, `StructureIR`, `SceneIR`, `SimulationIR`, and `ExecutionPackageIR` as the transport contract.
+- `src/autofdtd/core/validation.py` now centralizes Phase 1 normalization rules, unsupported-feature checks, primitive geometry sanity checks, simulation-bound checks, and zero-dimension boundary coercion.
+- `src/autofdtd/core/models.py` now provides the shared frozen model contract with `model_tag()`, `copy_update()`, `json_ready()`, and stable JSON serialization helpers reused by both public containers and IR models.
+- `src/autofdtd/geometry/primitives.py` now provides typed `Box`, `Sphere`, and `Cylinder` public models plus `GeometryTransform`, bounds, point-containment, and translation helpers.
+- `src/autofdtd/ir/models.py` now lowers primitive geometries into typed `BoxIR`, `SphereIR`, and `CylinderIR` payloads with explicit bounds and scene-compilation transform metadata.
+- `src/autofdtd/geometry/polyslab.py` now provides a typed `PolySlab` model for simple-polygon extrusions with bounds, containment, translation, and simple-polygon validation; `src/autofdtd/ir/models.py` lowers it into `PolySlabIR`.
+- `src/autofdtd/geometry/composite.py` now provides `GeometryGroup`, `Transformed`, `GeometryArray`, and a narrow `ClipOperation` subset (`union`, `intersection`, `difference`) for Phase 1 scene construction.
+- `GeometryTransform` now supports explicit rigid-transform composition plus translation, rotation, reflection, and conservative transformed-bounds evaluation for wrapper lowering and scene queries.
+- `src/autofdtd/ir/models.py` now carries typed wrapper IR via `GeometryGroupIR`, `TransformedIR`, and `ClipOperationIR`.
+- `GeometryArray` uses Tidy3D-style `geometry + offsets + transforms` public semantics, but Phase 1 keeps transforms rigid and linear-only and lowers arrays into explicit grouped instances for IR and overlap evaluation.
+- `Scene.structure_precedence()` and `Scene.resolve_structure_stack_at_point()` now expose concrete overlap order with `source_index`, `resolved_priority`, and `precedence_rank`, and `StructureIR` carries the same metadata for later compiler stages.
+- `src/autofdtd/grid/specs.py` now provides `AutoGrid`, `GridRefinement`, and `LayerRefinementSpec` in addition to the manual grid models; the current AutoGrid path is wavelength-driven, axis-local, and only applies axis-aligned layer refinement metadata.
+- `src/autofdtd/ir/models.py` now lowers `GridSpec` into typed grid IR with per-axis spec payloads, layer-refinement metadata, and resolved boundary and shape metadata, so later compiler work can consume inspectable discretization state instead of reparsing public models.
+
+## Decisions
+
+- Reserve subsystem namespaces now: `api`, `core`, `geometry`, `materials`, `boundaries`, `sources`, `monitors`, `grid`, `modes`, `ir`, `compiler`, `runtime`, `kernels`, `diagnostics`, `examples`.
+- Use `hatchling` with a `src/` layout and ship a small CLI (`autofdtd-feature-matrix`) so the scaffold has a concrete install/runtime smoke target before solver code exists.
+- Keep this task focused on packaging, docs, and planning metadata; full tagged models remain for `task-002` and `task-003`.
+- Model ordered overlap explicitly through `Scene.structures_in_resolution_order()`, sorting by resolved priority and then insertion order so later structures still win ties during sequential materialization.
+- Keep the initial container layer serialization-light: `to_payload()`, `to_json_text()`, and `write_json()` are enough for snapshots and handoff, while `task-005` can generalize the shared model base.
+- Use a generic family-tagged component envelope in the IR so Phase 1 can package realistic simulations before every feature family has concrete typed IR classes; later tasks can specialize payloads without changing bundle shape.
+- Bundle packaging is directory-based: `manifest.json` points at a hashed `simulation.json` entrypoint, avoiding self-referential manifest hashing while staying suitable for remote upload or local caching.
+- Core validation is checklist-driven: implemented feature tags pass, deferred or rejected tags fail early with explicit errors, and known primitive geometry payloads validate only when enough fields are present so placeholder tagged dicts can survive until their concrete family tasks land.
+- Shared model behavior should live in `autofdtd.core.models`; public API and IR classes should subclass it rather than duplicating serialization or copy helpers in subsystem-local base classes.
+- Primitive geometry stays axis-aligned in Phase 1 public models; scene-compilation transforms are still explicit so later `Transformed` and grouped-geometry tasks can lower onto the same contract instead of rewriting primitive handling.
+- Structure precedence is now inspectable with `Scene.resolve_structure_at_point()`, which mirrors materialization order by applying primitive containment checks in resolved-priority order.
+- Keep `GeometryArray` as a public wrapper only; repeated placements lower into ordinary grouped and transformed instances so runtime/compiler code can treat arrays as pre-expanded ordered geometry.
+- Phase 1 `PolySlab` scope is intentionally limited to constant-cross-section extrusions of simple polygons on principal axes; non-zero `dilation` or `sidewall_angle`, self-intersections, and curved or boolean polygon features must fail explicitly until later geometry tasks land.
+- Keep the feature ledger conservative for clipping: `ClipOperation` remains a deferred family in `planning.py`, but geometry validation explicitly allows the implemented subset and rejects unsupported boolean ops with clear errors.
+- Phase 1 transform wrappers are rigid only; free-form affine matrices and exact boolean meshing remain out of scope even though the public model now supports grouped and transformed composition.
+- Keep the top-level simulation grid surface strict: `grid_spec` must be a `GridSpec`, `AutoGrid` requires `GridSpec.wavelength`, and `QuasiUniformGrid` remains an explicit deferred error.
+- Phase 1 AutoGrid is deliberately narrow: derive a vacuum baseline from wavelength and domain size, discretize piecewise with a simple `max_scale` grading pass, and limit refinement inputs to `LayerRefinementSpec` body and bound hints rather than full geometry-driven meshing.
+
+## Task Handoffs
+
+- `task-003` should add versioned IR models under `autofdtd.ir` without coupling them to the public API module layout; it can treat `Simulation.to_payload()` as an interim handoff format, not the final IR contract.
+- Later geometry, material, source, and monitor tasks can plug concrete tagged models into the existing container fields without changing the ordered-container semantics.
+- `task-004` and `task-005` can reuse `ComponentIR.payload` plus the shared IR schema version constants instead of inventing another transport shape.
+- Later geometry, source, monitor, boundary, and grid tasks should route new object models through `autofdtd.core.validation.normalize_component()` or extend its equivalents instead of scattering policy checks across each family.
+- Later compiler work can rely on wrapper IR bounds as conservative planning envelopes; exact voxelization or boolean rasterization still belongs in scene compilation rather than the public geometry layer.
+- Later compiler work can consume `StructureIR.source_index` plus `StructureIR.precedence_rank` directly when building ordered region materialization plans or conflict diagnostics.
+- Later grid/compiler tasks should treat `LayerRefinementSpecIR` as planning metadata only; corner finding, snapping-point localization, and structure-derived meshing still need a separate scene-aware meshing pass.

+def _snap_to_axis(point: float, *, axis_min: float, axis_max: float, tolerance: float) -> float | None:
+    if point < axis_min - tolerance or point > axis_max + tolerance:
+        return None
+    if math.isclose(point, axis_min, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=tolerance):
+        return axis_min
+    if math.isclose(point, axis_max, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=tolerance):
+        return axis_max
+    return _finite_float(point, field_name="snapping point")
+
+
+def _axis_name_to_index(axis: AxisName | int) -> int:
+    if axis in (0, 1, 2):
+        return int(axis)
+    axis_map = {"x": 0, "y": 1, "z": 2}
+    if isinstance(axis, str) and axis.lower() in axis_map:
+        return axis_map[axis.lower()]
+    raise ValueError("axis must be one of 0, 1, 2, 'x', 'y', or 'z'")

+class GridRefinement(TaggedModel):
+    """Local refinement metadata for AutoGrid planning."""
+
+    type: Literal["GridRefinement"] = "GridRefinement"
+    refinement_factor: float | None = None
+    dl: float | None = None
+    num_cells: int = 3
+
+    @field_validator("refinement_factor")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_refinement_factor(cls, value: float | None) -> float | None:
+        if value is None:
+            return None
+        return _positive_float(value, field_name="refinement_factor")
+
+    @field_validator("dl")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_dl(cls, value: float | None) -> float | None:
+        if value is None:
+            return None
+        return _positive_float(value, field_name="dl")
+
+    @field_validator("num_cells")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_num_cells(cls, value: int) -> int:
+        return _positive_int(value, field_name="num_cells")
+
+    @property
+    def effective_refinement_factor(self) -> float | None:
+        """Return the refinement factor that should be applied in Phase 1."""
+        if self.refinement_factor is None and self.dl is None:
+            return _DEFAULT_REFINEMENT_FACTOR
+        return self.refinement_factor
+
+    def effective_dl(self, *, vacuum_dl: float) -> float:
+        """Return the smallest cell width requested by this refinement."""
+        base = _positive_float(vacuum_dl, field_name="vacuum_dl")
+        refined = math.inf
+        if self.effective_refinement_factor is not None:
+            refined = min(refined, base / self.effective_refinement_factor)
+        if self.dl is not None:
+            refined = min(refined, self.dl)
+        if not math.isfinite(refined):
+            raise ValueError("grid refinement could not determine a target dl")
+        return refined
+
+
+class LayerRefinementSpec(TaggedModel):
+    """Layer-aware AutoGrid refinement metadata with an explicit Phase 1 subset."""
+
+    type: Literal["LayerRefinementSpec"] = "LayerRefinementSpec"
+    axis: int
+    center: Vec3
+    size: Vec3
+    min_steps_along_axis: float | None = None
+    bounds_refinement: GridRefinement | None = None
+    bounds_snapping: Literal["bounds", "lower", "upper", "center"] | None = "lower"
+
+    @field_validator("axis")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_axis(cls, value: int) -> int:
+        return _axis_name_to_index(value)
+
+    @field_validator("center")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_center(cls, value: Vec3) -> Vec3:
+        return tuple(_finite_float(component, field_name="center") for component in value)
+
+    @field_validator("size")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_size(cls, value: Vec3) -> Vec3:
+        normalized = tuple(_finite_float(component, field_name="size") for component in value)
+        if any(component < 0.0 for component in normalized):
+            raise ValueError("size components must be non-negative")
+        return normalized
+
+    @field_validator("min_steps_along_axis")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_min_steps(cls, value: float | None) -> float | None:
+        if value is None:
+            return None
+        return _positive_float(value, field_name="min_steps_along_axis")
+
+    @property
+    def bounds(self) -> tuple[Vec3, Vec3]:
+        """Return axis-aligned layer bounds."""
+        lower = tuple(c - s / 2.0 for c, s in zip(self.center, self.size, strict=True))
+        upper = tuple(c + s / 2.0 for c, s in zip(self.center, self.size, strict=True))
+        return (lower, upper)
+
+    def axis_bounds(self) -> tuple[float, float]:
+        """Return the lower and upper coordinates along the normal axis."""
+        lower, upper = self.bounds
+        return (lower[self.axis], upper[self.axis])
+
+    def snapping_points(self) -> tuple[float, ...]:
+        """Return snapping points implied by the current layer configuration."""
+        lower, upper = self.axis_bounds()
+        center = self.center[self.axis]
+        mode = self.bounds_snapping
+        if mode is None:
+            return ()
+        if mode == "bounds":
+            return (lower, upper)
+        if mode == "lower":
+            return (lower,)
+        if mode == "upper":
+            return (upper,)
+        return (center,)
+
+    def target_dl(self, *, base_dl: float) -> float | None:
+        """Return the smallest requested dl inside the layer body, if any."""
+        target = math.inf
+        thickness = self.size[self.axis]
+        if self.min_steps_along_axis is not None and thickness > 0.0:
+            target = min(target, thickness / math.ceil(self.min_steps_along_axis))
+        if self.bounds_refinement is not None:
+            target = min(target, self.bounds_refinement.effective_dl(vacuum_dl=base_dl))
+        if not math.isfinite(target):
+            return None
+        return target
+
+
+class AutoGrid(TaggedModel):
+    """Simplified AutoGrid meshing policy with explicit Phase 1 limitations."""
+
+    type: Literal["AutoGrid"] = "AutoGrid"
+    min_steps_per_wvl: float = _DEFAULT_AUTOGRID_STEPS_PER_WVL
+    min_steps_per_sim_size: float = _DEFAULT_AUTOGRID_STEPS_PER_SIM_SIZE
+    max_scale: float = _DEFAULT_AUTOGRID_MAX_SCALE
+    dl_min: float | None = None
+
+    @field_validator("min_steps_per_wvl")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_min_steps_per_wvl(cls, value: float) -> float:
+        numeric = _positive_float(value, field_name="min_steps_per_wvl")
+        if numeric < 6.0:
+            raise ValueError("min_steps_per_wvl must be at least 6.0 for Phase 1 AutoGrid")
+        return numeric
+
+    @field_validator("min_steps_per_sim_size")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_min_steps_per_sim_size(cls, value: float) -> float:
+        if float(value) < 1.0:
+            raise ValueError("min_steps_per_sim_size must be at least 1.0")
+        return _positive_float(value, field_name="min_steps_per_sim_size")
+
+    @field_validator("max_scale")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_max_scale(cls, value: float) -> float:
+        numeric = _positive_float(value, field_name="max_scale")
+        if numeric < 1.0:
+            raise ValueError("max_scale must be at least 1.0")
+        return numeric
+
+    @field_validator("dl_min")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_dl_min(cls, value: float | None) -> float | None:
+        if value is None:
+            return None
+        return _positive_float(value, field_name="dl_min")
+
+    def estimated_min_dl(self, *, wavelength: float, sim_size: Vec3) -> float:
+        """Return the Phase 1 vacuum-based lower bound for this AutoGrid."""
+        wavelength_dl = _positive_float(wavelength, field_name="wavelength") / self.min_steps_per_wvl
+        sim_dl = max(_positive_float(length, field_name="sim_size") for length in sim_size if length > 0.0)
+        sim_dl /= self.min_steps_per_sim_size
+        target = min(wavelength_dl, sim_dl)
+        if self.dl_min is not None:
+            target = max(target, self.dl_min)
+        return target
+
+    def make_boundaries(
+        self,
+        *,
+        center: float,
+        size: float,
+        wavelength: float,
+        sim_size: Vec3,
+        layer_refinement_specs: Iterable[LayerRefinementSpec] = (),
+    ) -> tuple[float, ...]:
+        """Resolve a simplified AutoGrid axis with optional layer refinement metadata."""
+        axis_min, axis_max = _normalize_axis_bounds(center=center, size=size)
+        tolerance = max(1e-12, abs(size) * 1e-9)
+        if math.isclose(axis_min, axis_max, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=tolerance):
+            return (axis_min, axis_max)
+
+        base_dl = self.estimated_min_dl(wavelength=wavelength, sim_size=sim_size)
+        regions: list[tuple[float, float, float]] = []
+        snapping_points = {axis_min, axis_max}
+
+        for spec in layer_refinement_specs:
+            lower, upper = spec.axis_bounds()
+            clipped_lower = max(axis_min, lower)
+            clipped_upper = min(axis_max, upper)
+            if clipped_upper < axis_min - tolerance or clipped_lower > axis_max + tolerance:
+                continue
+
+            target_dl = spec.target_dl(base_dl=base_dl)
+            if target_dl is not None and clipped_upper - clipped_lower > tolerance:
+                regions.append((clipped_lower, clipped_upper, target_dl))
+
+            if spec.bounds_refinement is not None:
+                boundary_dl = spec.bounds_refinement.effective_dl(vacuum_dl=base_dl)
+                half_width = boundary_dl * spec.bounds_refinement.num_cells / 2.0
+                for point in spec.snapping_points():
+                    snapped = _snap_to_axis(
+                        point, axis_min=axis_min, axis_max=axis_max, tolerance=tolerance
+                    )
+                    if snapped is None:
+                        continue
+                    snapping_points.add(snapped)
+                    regions.append(
+                        (
+                            max(axis_min, snapped - half_width),
+                            min(axis_max, snapped + half_width),
+                            boundary_dl,
+                        )
+                    )
+            else:
+                for point in spec.snapping_points():
+                    snapped = _snap_to_axis(
+                        point, axis_min=axis_min, axis_max=axis_max, tolerance=tolerance
+                    )
+                    if snapped is not None:
+                        snapping_points.add(snapped)
+
+        breakpoints = sorted(snapping_points | {start for start, _, _ in regions} | {end for _, end, _ in regions})
+        boundaries = [axis_min]
+        for segment_start, segment_end in zip(breakpoints, breakpoints[1:], strict=False):
+            if math.isclose(segment_start, segment_end, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=tolerance):
+                continue
+            midpoint = (segment_start + segment_end) / 2.0
+            target_dl = min(
+                (dl for start, end, dl in regions if start - tolerance <= midpoint <= end + tolerance),
+                default=base_dl,
+            )
+            num_cells = max(1, math.ceil((segment_end - segment_start) / target_dl))
+            snapped_dl = (segment_end - segment_start) / num_cells
+            for index in range(1, num_cells + 1):
+                boundaries.append(segment_start + snapped_dl * index)
+
+        graded = self._enforce_max_scale(boundaries, tolerance=tolerance)
+        return _deduplicate_coords(graded, tolerance=tolerance)
+
+    def _enforce_max_scale(self, boundaries: list[float], *, tolerance: float) -> list[float]:
+        if len(boundaries) < 3 or self.max_scale <= 1.0:
+            return boundaries
+
+        graded = list(boundaries)
+        changed = True
+        while changed:
+            changed = False
+            cell_sizes = [upper - lower for lower, upper in zip(graded, graded[1:], strict=False)]
+            for index in range(len(cell_sizes) - 1):
+                left = cell_sizes[index]
+                right = cell_sizes[index + 1]
+                if left <= tolerance or right <= tolerance:
+                    continue
+                ratio = max(left, right) / min(left, right)
+                if ratio <= self.max_scale + 1e-12:
+                    continue
+                if left > right:
+                    graded.insert(index + 1, (graded[index] + graded[index + 1]) / 2.0)
+                else:
+                    graded.insert(index + 2, (graded[index + 1] + graded[index + 2]) / 2.0)
+                changed = True
+                break
+        return graded
+

   260	    def make_boundaries(self, *, center: float, size: float) -> tuple[float, ...]:
   261	        """Return aligned axis boundaries, extending edge cells as needed."""
   262	        axis_min, axis_max = _normalize_axis_bounds(center=center, size=size)
   263	        if math.isclose(axis_min, axis_max, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=1e-12):
   264	            return (axis_min, axis_max)
   265	
   266	        cumulative = [0.0]
   267	        for step in self.dl:
   268	            cumulative.append(cumulative[-1] + step)
   269

   271	        if offset is None:
   272	            offset = center - cumulative[-1] / 2.0
   273	        boundaries = [offset + value for value in cumulative]

   283	        ]

   301

   316	        """Return the refinement factor that should be applied in Phase 1."""
   317	        if self.refinement_factor is None and self.dl is None:

   321	    def effective_dl(self, *, vacuum_dl: float) -> float:

   449	    def estimated_min_dl(self, *, wavelength: float, sim_size: Vec3) -> float:
   450	        """Return the Phase 1 vacuum-based lower bound for this AutoGrid."""
   451	        wavelength_dl = _positive_float(wavelength, field_name="wavelength") / self.min_steps_per_wvl
   452	        sim_dl = max(_positive_float(length, field_name="sim_size") for length in sim_size if length > 0.0)
   453	        sim_dl /= self.min_steps_per_sim_size

   459	    def make_boundaries(
   460	        self,
   461	        *,
   462	        center: float,
   463	        size: float,
   464	        wavelength: float,
   465	        sim_size: Vec3,
   466	        layer_refinement_specs: Iterable[LayerRefinementSpec] = (),
   467	    ) -> tuple[float, ...]:
   468	        """Resolve a simplified AutoGrid axis with optional layer refinement metadata."""
   469	        axis_min, axis_max = _normalize_axis_bounds(center=center, size=size)
   470	        tolerance = max(1e-12, abs(size) * 1e-9)
   471	        if math.isclose(axis_min, axis_max, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=tolerance):
   472	            return (axis_min, axis_max)
   473	
   474	        base_dl = self.estimated_min_dl(wavelength=wavelength, sim_size=sim_size)
   475	        regions: list[tuple[float, float, float]] = []
   476	        snapping_points = {axis_min, axis_max}
   477	
   478	        for spec in layer_refinement_specs:
   479	            lower, upper = spec.axis_bounds()
   480	            clipped_lower = max(axis_min, lower)
   481	            clipped_upper = min(axis_max, upper)
   482	            if clipped_upper < axis_min - tolerance or clipped_lower > axis_max + tolerance:
   483	                continue
   484	
   485	            target_dl = spec.target_dl(base_dl=base_dl)
   486	            if target_dl is not None and clipped_upper - clipped_lower > tolerance:
   487	                regions.append((clipped_lower, clipped_upper, target_dl))
   488	
   489	            if spec.bounds_refinement is not None:
   490	                boundary_dl = spec.bounds_refinement.effective_dl(vacuum_dl=base_dl)
   491	                half_width = boundary_dl * spec.bounds_refinement.num_cells / 2.0
   492	                for point in spec.snapping_points():
   493	                    snapped = _snap_to_axis(
   494	                        point, axis_min=axis_min, axis_max=axis_max, tolerance=tolerance
   495	                    )
   496	                    if snapped is None:
   497	                        continue
   498	                    snapping_points.add(snapped)
   499	                    regions.append(
   500	                        (
   501	                            max(axis_min, snapped - half_width),
   502	                            min(axis_max, snapped + half_width),
   503	                            boundary_dl,
   504	                        )
   505	                    )
   506	            else:
   507	                for point in spec.snapping_points():
   508	                    snapped = _snap_to_axis(
   509	                        point, axis_min=axis_min, axis_max=axis_max, tolerance=tolerance
   510	                    )
   511	                    if snapped is not None:
   512	                        snapping_points.add(snapped)
   513	
   514	        breakpoints = sorted(snapping_points | {start for start, _, _ in regions} | {end for _, end, _ in regions})
   515	        boundaries = [axis_min]
   516	        for segment_start, segment_end in zip(breakpoints, breakpoints[1:], strict=False):
   517	            if math.isclose(segment_start, segment_end, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=tolerance):
   518	                continue
   519	            midpoint = (segment_start + segment_end) / 2.0
   520	            target_dl = min(
   521	                (dl for start, end, dl in regions if start - tolerance <= midpoint <= end + tolerance),
   522	                default=base_dl,
   523	            )
   524	            num_cells = max(1, math.ceil((segment_end - segment_start) / target_dl))
   525	            snapped_dl = (segment_end - segment_start) / num_cells
   526	            for index in range(1, num_cells + 1):
   527	                boundaries.append(segment_start + snapped_dl * index)
   528	
   529	        graded = self._enforce_max_scale(boundaries, tolerance=tolerance)
   530	        return _deduplicate_coords(graded, tolerance=tolerance)
   531	
   532	    def _enforce_max_scale(self, boundaries: list[float], *, tolerance: float) -> list[float]:
   533	        if len(boundaries) < 3 or self.max_scale <= 1.0:
   534	            return boundaries
   535	
   536	        graded = list(boundaries)
   537	        changed = True
   538	        while changed:
   539	            changed = False
   540	            cell_sizes = [upper - lower for lower, upper in zip(graded, graded[1:], strict=False)]
   541	            for index in range(len(cell_sizes) - 1):
   542	                left = cell_sizes[index]
   543	                right = cell_sizes[index + 1]
   544	                if left <= tolerance or right <= tolerance:
   545	                    continue
   546	                ratio = max(left, right) / min(left, right)
   547	                if ratio <= self.max_scale + 1e-12:
   548	                    continue
   549	                if left > right:
   550	                    graded.insert(index + 1, (graded[index] + graded[index + 1]) / 2.0)
   551	                else:
   552	                    graded.insert(index + 2, (graded[index + 1] + graded[index + 2]) / 2.0)
   553	                changed = True
   554	                break
   555	        return graded
   556

   565	    """Collective grid specification for the three principal axes."""
   566	
   567	    type: Literal["GridSpec"] = "GridSpec"
   568	    grid_x: AxisGridSpec = Field(default_factory=lambda: UniformGrid(dl=_DEFAULT_UNIFORM_DL))
   569	    grid_y: AxisGridSpec = Field(default_factory=lambda: UniformGrid(dl=_DEFAULT_UNIFORM_DL))
   570	    grid_z: AxisGridSpec = Field(default_factory=lambda: UniformGrid(dl=_DEFAULT_UNIFORM_DL))
   571	    wavelength: float | None = None
   572	    layer_refinement_specs: tuple[LayerRefinementSpec, ...] = ()
   573	
   574	    @field_validator("wavelength")
   575	    @classmethod
   576	    def _validate_wavelength(cls, value: float | None) -> float | None:
   577	        if value is None:
   578	            return None
   579	        return _positive_float(value, field_name="wavelength")
   580	
   581	    @classmethod
   582	    def uniform(cls, dl: float) -> GridSpec:
   583	        """Return a uniform grid specification across all three axes."""
   584	        uniform = UniformGrid(dl=dl)
   585	        return cls(grid_x=uniform, grid_y=uniform, grid_z=uniform)
   586	
   587	    def axis_spec(self, axis: AxisName) -> AxisGridSpec:
   588	        """Return the axis-local grid specification."""
   589	        return getattr(self, f"grid_{axis}")
   590	
   591	    def resolve_axis(
   592	        self,
   593	        axis: AxisName,
   594	        *,
   595	        center: float,
   596	        size: float,
   597	        sim_size: Vec3,
   598	    ) -> ResolvedGridAxis:
   599	        """Resolve one axis against the simulation domain."""
   600	        spec = self.axis_spec(axis)
   601	        if isinstance(spec, AutoGrid):
   602	            if self.wavelength is None:
   603	                raise ValueError("GridSpec.wavelength is required when any axis uses AutoGrid")
   604	            axis_index = _axis_name_to_index(axis)
   605	            layer_specs = tuple(
   606	                item for item in self.layer_refinement_specs if item.axis == axis_index
   607	            )
   608	            boundaries = spec.make_boundaries(
   609	                center=center,
   610	                size=size,
   611	                wavelength=self.wavelength,
   612	                sim_size=sim_size,
   613	                layer_refinement_specs=layer_specs,
   614	            )
   615	        else:
   616	            boundaries = spec.make_boundaries(center=center, size=size)
   617	        return ResolvedGridAxis(axis=axis, boundaries=boundaries)
   618	
   619	    def make_grid(self, *, center: Vec3, size: Vec3) -> ResolvedGrid:
   620	        """Resolve all axes into a concrete discretization layout."""

   417	def _sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
   418	    digest = sha256()

   424	    if isinstance(value, BaseModel):

     1	# Grid Scope
     2	
     3	Phase 1 grid support now covers both explicit manual discretization and a first
     4	AutoGrid-style planning path with inspectable layer-refinement metadata.
     5	
     6	## Implemented Models
     7	
     8	- `UniformGrid` for constant step size on one axis
     9	- `CustomGrid` for explicit cell sizes with edge-cell extension to cover the full domain
    10	- `CustomGridBoundaries` for fully explicit axis boundary coordinates
    11	- `GridSpec` as the top-level container that resolves all three axes together
    12	- `AutoGrid` for vacuum-scale-driven meshing with wavelength-aware spacing
    13	- `GridRefinement` for local refinement targets used by AutoGrid planning
    14	- `LayerRefinementSpec` for axis-aligned layer snapping and bounds refinement
    15	
    16	```python
    17	from autofdtd.api import (
    18	    AutoGrid,
    19	    CustomGrid,
    20	    CustomGridBoundaries,
    21	    GridRefinement,
    22	    GridSpec,
    23	    LayerRefinementSpec,
    24	    UniformGrid,
    25	)
    26	
    27	grid_spec = GridSpec(
    28	    grid_x=UniformGrid(dl=0.02),
    29	    grid_y=CustomGrid(dl=(0.03, 0.02, 0.03)),
    30	    grid_z=CustomGridBoundaries(coords=(-2.0, -0.5, 0.5, 2.0)),
    31	)
    32	resolved = grid_spec.make_grid(center=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0), size=(12.0, 8.0, 4.0))
    33	
    34	auto = GridSpec(
    35	    grid_x=AutoGrid(min_steps_per_wvl=16, max_scale=1.6),
    36	    grid_y=UniformGrid(dl=0.05),
    37	    grid_z=UniformGrid(dl=0.05),
    38	    wavelength=1.55,
    39	    layer_refinement_specs=(
    40	        LayerRefinementSpec(
    41	            axis=0,
    42	            center=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0),
    43	            size=(0.22, 1.0, 1.0),
    44	            min_steps_along_axis=6,
    45	            bounds_refinement=GridRefinement(refinement_factor=2.0, num_cells=5),
    46	            bounds_snapping="bounds",
    47	        ),
    48	    ),
    49	)
    50	```
    51	
    52	## Resolution Behavior
    53	
    54	- `UniformGrid` snaps the final step size so the axis length is covered exactly
    55	- `CustomGrid` centers the supplied pattern by default and repeats the first and last
    56	  cell sizes as needed to reach the domain bounds
    57	- `CustomGridBoundaries` must already start and end on the simulation axis bounds
    58	- `AutoGrid` currently derives a vacuum baseline from `wavelength`,
    59	  `min_steps_per_wvl`, and `min_steps_per_sim_size`, then applies a simplified
    60	  graded piecewise discretization
    61	- `LayerRefinementSpec` currently affects only matching `AutoGrid` axes and only
    62	  through layer-thickness refinement plus snapping or refinement around layer bounds
    63	- `Simulation.resolved_grid()` now validates and exposes the concrete Phase 1 grid
    64	  layout for later compiler, runtime, and mode-solver work
    65	
    66	## Explicit Phase 1 Limits
    67

+def _snap_to_axis(point: float, *, axis_min: float, axis_max: float, tolerance: float) -> float | None:
+    if point < axis_min - tolerance or point > axis_max + tolerance:
+        return None
+    if math.isclose(point, axis_min, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=tolerance):
+        return axis_min
+    if math.isclose(point, axis_max, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=tolerance):
+        return axis_max
+    return _finite_float(point, field_name="snapping point")
+
+
+def _axis_name_to_index(axis: AxisName | int) -> int:
+    if axis in (0, 1, 2):
+        return int(axis)
+    axis_map = {"x": 0, "y": 1, "z": 2}
+    if isinstance(axis, str) and axis.lower() in axis_map:
+        return axis_map[axis.lower()]
+    raise ValueError("axis must be one of 0, 1, 2, 'x', 'y', or 'z'")

+class GridRefinement(TaggedModel):
+    """Local refinement metadata for AutoGrid planning."""
+
+    type: Literal["GridRefinement"] = "GridRefinement"
+    refinement_factor: float | None = None
+    dl: float | None = None
+    num_cells: int = 3
+
+    @field_validator("refinement_factor")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_refinement_factor(cls, value: float | None) -> float | None:
+        if value is None:
+            return None
+        return _positive_float(value, field_name="refinement_factor")
+
+    @field_validator("dl")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_dl(cls, value: float | None) -> float | None:
+        if value is None:
+            return None
+        return _positive_float(value, field_name="dl")
+
+    @field_validator("num_cells")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_num_cells(cls, value: int) -> int:
+        return _positive_int(value, field_name="num_cells")
+
+    @property
+    def effective_refinement_factor(self) -> float | None:
+        """Return the refinement factor that should be applied in Phase 1."""
+        if self.refinement_factor is None and self.dl is None:
+            return _DEFAULT_REFINEMENT_FACTOR
+        return self.refinement_factor
+
+    def effective_dl(self, *, vacuum_dl: float) -> float:
+        """Return the smallest cell width requested by this refinement."""
+        base = _positive_float(vacuum_dl, field_name="vacuum_dl")
+        refined = math.inf
+        if self.effective_refinement_factor is not None:
+            refined = min(refined, base / self.effective_refinement_factor)
+        if self.dl is not None:
+            refined = min(refined, self.dl)
+        if not math.isfinite(refined):
+            raise ValueError("grid refinement could not determine a target dl")
+        return refined
+
+
+class LayerRefinementSpec(TaggedModel):
+    """Layer-aware AutoGrid refinement metadata with an explicit Phase 1 subset."""
+
+    type: Literal["LayerRefinementSpec"] = "LayerRefinementSpec"
+    axis: int
+    center: Vec3
+    size: Vec3
+    min_steps_along_axis: float | None = None
+    bounds_refinement: GridRefinement | None = None
+    bounds_snapping: Literal["bounds", "lower", "upper", "center"] | None = "lower"
+
+    @field_validator("axis")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_axis(cls, value: int) -> int:
+        return _axis_name_to_index(value)
+
+    @field_validator("center")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_center(cls, value: Vec3) -> Vec3:
+        return tuple(_finite_float(component, field_name="center") for component in value)
+
+    @field_validator("size")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_size(cls, value: Vec3) -> Vec3:
+        normalized = tuple(_finite_float(component, field_name="size") for component in value)
+        if any(component < 0.0 for component in normalized):
+            raise ValueError("size components must be non-negative")
+        return normalized
+
+    @field_validator("min_steps_along_axis")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_min_steps(cls, value: float | None) -> float | None:
+        if value is None:
+            return None
+        return _positive_float(value, field_name="min_steps_along_axis")
+
+    @property
+    def bounds(self) -> tuple[Vec3, Vec3]:
+        """Return axis-aligned layer bounds."""
+        lower = tuple(c - s / 2.0 for c, s in zip(self.center, self.size, strict=True))
+        upper = tuple(c + s / 2.0 for c, s in zip(self.center, self.size, strict=True))
+        return (lower, upper)
+
+    def axis_bounds(self) -> tuple[float, float]:
+        """Return the lower and upper coordinates along the normal axis."""
+        lower, upper = self.bounds
+        return (lower[self.axis], upper[self.axis])
+
+    def snapping_points(self) -> tuple[float, ...]:
+        """Return snapping points implied by the current layer configuration."""
+        lower, upper = self.axis_bounds()
+        center = self.center[self.axis]
+        mode = self.bounds_snapping
+        if mode is None:
+            return ()
+        if mode == "bounds":
+            return (lower, upper)
+        if mode == "lower":
+            return (lower,)
+        if mode == "upper":
+            return (upper,)
+        return (center,)
+
+    def target_dl(self, *, base_dl: float) -> float | None:
+        """Return the smallest requested dl inside the layer body, if any."""
+        target = math.inf
+        thickness = self.size[self.axis]
+        if self.min_steps_along_axis is not None and thickness > 0.0:
+            target = min(target, thickness / math.ceil(self.min_steps_along_axis))
+        if self.bounds_refinement is not None:
+            target = min(target, self.bounds_refinement.effective_dl(vacuum_dl=base_dl))
+        if not math.isfinite(target):
+            return None
+        return target
+
+
+class AutoGrid(TaggedModel):
+    """Simplified AutoGrid meshing policy with explicit Phase 1 limitations."""
+
+    type: Literal["AutoGrid"] = "AutoGrid"
+    min_steps_per_wvl: float = _DEFAULT_AUTOGRID_STEPS_PER_WVL
+    min_steps_per_sim_size: float = _DEFAULT_AUTOGRID_STEPS_PER_SIM_SIZE
+    max_scale: float = _DEFAULT_AUTOGRID_MAX_SCALE
+    dl_min: float | None = None
+
+    @field_validator("min_steps_per_wvl")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_min_steps_per_wvl(cls, value: float) -> float:
+        numeric = _positive_float(value, field_name="min_steps_per_wvl")
+        if numeric < 6.0:
+            raise ValueError("min_steps_per_wvl must be at least 6.0 for Phase 1 AutoGrid")
+        return numeric
+
+    @field_validator("min_steps_per_sim_size")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_min_steps_per_sim_size(cls, value: float) -> float:
+        if float(value) < 1.0:
+            raise ValueError("min_steps_per_sim_size must be at least 1.0")
+        return _positive_float(value, field_name="min_steps_per_sim_size")
+
+    @field_validator("max_scale")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_max_scale(cls, value: float) -> float:
+        numeric = _positive_float(value, field_name="max_scale")
+        if numeric < 1.0:
+            raise ValueError("max_scale must be at least 1.0")
+        return numeric
+
+    @field_validator("dl_min")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_dl_min(cls, value: float | None) -> float | None:
+        if value is None:
+            return None
+        return _positive_float(value, field_name="dl_min")
+
+    def estimated_min_dl(self, *, wavelength: float, sim_size: Vec3) -> float:
+        """Return the Phase 1 vacuum-based lower bound for this AutoGrid."""
+        wavelength_dl = _positive_float(wavelength, field_name="wavelength") / self.min_steps_per_wvl
+        sim_dl = max(_positive_float(length, field_name="sim_size") for length in sim_size if length > 0.0)
+        sim_dl /= self.min_steps_per_sim_size
+        target = min(wavelength_dl, sim_dl)
+        if self.dl_min is not None:
+            target = max(target, self.dl_min)
+        return target
+
+    def make_boundaries(
+        self,
+        *,
+        center: float,
+        size: float,
+        wavelength: float,
+        sim_size: Vec3,
+        layer_refinement_specs: Iterable[LayerRefinementSpec] = (),
+    ) -> tuple[float, ...]:
+        """Resolve a simplified AutoGrid axis with optional layer refinement metadata."""
+        axis_min, axis_max = _normalize_axis_bounds(center=center, size=size)
+        tolerance = max(1e-12, abs(size) * 1e-9)
+        if math.isclose(axis_min, axis_max, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=tolerance):
+            return (axis_min, axis_max)
+
+        base_dl = self.estimated_min_dl(wavelength=wavelength, sim_size=sim_size)
+        regions: list[tuple[float, float, float]] = []
+        snapping_points = {axis_min, axis_max}
+
+        for spec in layer_refinement_specs:
+            lower, upper = spec.axis_bounds()
+            clipped_lower = max(axis_min, lower)
+            clipped_upper = min(axis_max, upper)
+            if clipped_upper < axis_min - tolerance or clipped_lower > axis_max + tolerance:
+                continue
+
+            target_dl = spec.target_dl(base_dl=base_dl)
+            if target_dl is not None and clipped_upper - clipped_lower > tolerance:
+                regions.append((clipped_lower, clipped_upper, target_dl))
+
+            if spec.bounds_refinement is not None:
+                boundary_dl = spec.bounds_refinement.effective_dl(vacuum_dl=base_dl)
+                half_width = boundary_dl * spec.bounds_refinement.num_cells / 2.0
+                for point in spec.snapping_points():
+                    snapped = _snap_to_axis(
+                        point, axis_min=axis_min, axis_max=axis_max, tolerance=tolerance
+                    )
+                    if snapped is None:
+                        continue
+                    snapping_points.add(snapped)
+                    regions.append(
+                        (
+                            max(axis_min, snapped - half_width),
+                            min(axis_max, snapped + half_width),
+                            boundary_dl,
+                        )
+                    )
+            else:
+                for point in spec.snapping_points():
+                    snapped = _snap_to_axis(
+                        point, axis_min=axis_min, axis_max=axis_max, tolerance=tolerance
+                    )
+                    if snapped is not None:
+                        snapping_points.add(snapped)
+
+        breakpoints = sorted(snapping_points | {start for start, _, _ in regions} | {end for _, end, _ in regions})
+        boundaries = [axis_min]
+        for segment_start, segment_end in zip(breakpoints, breakpoints[1:], strict=False):
+            if math.isclose(segment_start, segment_end, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=tolerance):
+                continue
+            midpoint = (segment_start + segment_end) / 2.0
+            target_dl = min(
+                (dl for start, end, dl in regions if start - tolerance <= midpoint <= end + tolerance),
+                default=base_dl,
+            )
+            num_cells = max(1, math.ceil((segment_end - segment_start) / target_dl))
+            snapped_dl = (segment_end - segment_start) / num_cells
+            for index in range(1, num_cells + 1):
+                boundaries.append(segment_start + snapped_dl * index)
+
+        graded = self._enforce_max_scale(boundaries, tolerance=tolerance)
+        return _deduplicate_coords(graded, tolerance=tolerance)
+
+    def _enforce_max_scale(self, boundaries: list[float], *, tolerance: float) -> list[float]:
+        if len(boundaries) < 3 or self.max_scale <= 1.0:
+            return boundaries
+
+        graded = list(boundaries)
+        changed = True
+        while changed:
+            changed = False
+            cell_sizes = [upper - lower for lower, upper in zip(graded, graded[1:], strict=False)]
+            for index in range(len(cell_sizes) - 1):
+                left = cell_sizes[index]
+                right = cell_sizes[index + 1]
+                if left <= tolerance or right <= tolerance:
+                    continue
+                ratio = max(left, right) / min(left, right)
+                if ratio <= self.max_scale + 1e-12:
+                    continue
+                if left > right:
+                    graded.insert(index + 1, (graded[index] + graded[index + 1]) / 2.0)
+                else:
+                    graded.insert(index + 2, (graded[index + 1] + graded[index + 2]) / 2.0)
+                changed = True
+                break
+        return graded
+

+def _snap_to_axis(point: float, *, axis_min: float, axis_max: float, tolerance: float) -> float | None:
+    if point < axis_min - tolerance or point > axis_max + tolerance:
+        return None
+    if math.isclose(point, axis_min, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=tolerance):
+        return axis_min
+    if math.isclose(point, axis_max, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=tolerance):
+        return axis_max
+    return _finite_float(point, field_name="snapping point")
+
+
+def _axis_name_to_index(axis: AxisName | int) -> int:
+    if axis in (0, 1, 2):
+        return int(axis)
+    axis_map = {"x": 0, "y": 1, "z": 2}
+    if isinstance(axis, str) and axis.lower() in axis_map:
+        return axis_map[axis.lower()]
+    raise ValueError("axis must be one of 0, 1, 2, 'x', 'y', or 'z'")

+class GridRefinement(TaggedModel):
+    """Local refinement metadata for AutoGrid planning."""
+
+    type: Literal["GridRefinement"] = "GridRefinement"
+    refinement_factor: float | None = None
+    dl: float | None = None
+    num_cells: int = 3
+
+    @field_validator("refinement_factor")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_refinement_factor(cls, value: float | None) -> float | None:
+        if value is None:
+            return None
+        return _positive_float(value, field_name="refinement_factor")
+
+    @field_validator("dl")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_dl(cls, value: float | None) -> float | None:
+        if value is None:
+            return None
+        return _positive_float(value, field_name="dl")
+
+    @field_validator("num_cells")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_num_cells(cls, value: int) -> int:
+        return _positive_int(value, field_name="num_cells")
+
+    @property
+    def effective_refinement_factor(self) -> float | None:
+        """Return the refinement factor that should be applied in Phase 1."""
+        if self.refinement_factor is None and self.dl is None:
+            return _DEFAULT_REFINEMENT_FACTOR
+        return self.refinement_factor
+
+    def effective_dl(self, *, vacuum_dl: float) -> float:
+        """Return the smallest cell width requested by this refinement."""
+        base = _positive_float(vacuum_dl, field_name="vacuum_dl")
+        refined = math.inf
+        if self.effective_refinement_factor is not None:
+            refined = min(refined, base / self.effective_refinement_factor)
+        if self.dl is not None:
+            refined = min(refined, self.dl)
+        if not math.isfinite(refined):
+            raise ValueError("grid refinement could not determine a target dl")
+        return refined
+
+
+class LayerRefinementSpec(TaggedModel):
+    """Layer-aware AutoGrid refinement metadata with an explicit Phase 1 subset."""
+
+    type: Literal["LayerRefinementSpec"] = "LayerRefinementSpec"
+    axis: int
+    center: Vec3
+    size: Vec3
+    min_steps_along_axis: float | None = None
+    bounds_refinement: GridRefinement | None = None
+    bounds_snapping: Literal["bounds", "lower", "upper", "center"] | None = "lower"
+
+    @field_validator("axis")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_axis(cls, value: int) -> int:
+        return _axis_name_to_index(value)
+
+    @field_validator("center")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_center(cls, value: Vec3) -> Vec3:
+        return tuple(_finite_float(component, field_name="center") for component in value)
+
+    @field_validator("size")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_size(cls, value: Vec3) -> Vec3:
+        normalized = tuple(_finite_float(component, field_name="size") for component in value)
+        if any(component < 0.0 for component in normalized):
+            raise ValueError("size components must be non-negative")
+        return normalized
+
+    @field_validator("min_steps_along_axis")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_min_steps(cls, value: float | None) -> float | None:
+        if value is None:
+            return None
+        return _positive_float(value, field_name="min_steps_along_axis")
+
+    @property
+    def bounds(self) -> tuple[Vec3, Vec3]:
+        """Return axis-aligned layer bounds."""
+        lower = tuple(c - s / 2.0 for c, s in zip(self.center, self.size, strict=True))
+        upper = tuple(c + s / 2.0 for c, s in zip(self.center, self.size, strict=True))
+        return (lower, upper)
+
+    def axis_bounds(self) -> tuple[float, float]:
+        """Return the lower and upper coordinates along the normal axis."""
+        lower, upper = self.bounds
+        return (lower[self.axis], upper[self.axis])
+
+    def snapping_points(self) -> tuple[float, ...]:
+        """Return snapping points implied by the current layer configuration."""
+        lower, upper = self.axis_bounds()
+        center = self.center[self.axis]
+        mode = self.bounds_snapping
+        if mode is None:
+            return ()
+        if mode == "bounds":
+            return (lower, upper)
+        if mode == "lower":
+            return (lower,)
+        if mode == "upper":
+            return (upper,)
+        return (center,)
+
+    def target_dl(self, *, base_dl: float) -> float | None:
+        """Return the smallest requested dl inside the layer body, if any."""
+        target = math.inf
+        thickness = self.size[self.axis]
+        if self.min_steps_along_axis is not None and thickness > 0.0:
+            target = min(target, thickness / math.ceil(self.min_steps_along_axis))
+        if self.bounds_refinement is not None:
+            target = min(target, self.bounds_refinement.effective_dl(vacuum_dl=base_dl))
+        if not math.isfinite(target):
+            return None
+        return target
+
